releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.4

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Automations: preserve authenticated operator authority for explicit same-conversation scheduled follow-ups, including one-shot `next_check` rearming, while retaining role, session, cancellation, target, and tool-policy revocation boundaries. (#176422) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Gateway security: keep an environment-referenced `hooks.token` out of agent host-exec and CLI child environments at startup and across config reloads, while preserving explicit per-command overrides. (#179199) Thanks @VACInc and @RomneyDa.
- Memory Wiki: preserve human-authored Notes when OKF concept pages are re-imported or removed from the producer bundle, including changed producer content and legacy pages without a marked Notes slot. (#175707, #179657; related #175700) Thanks @YangManBOBO and @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI: keep the native Claude session and its context when subagent completions or channel turns run in a Control UI-started session, instead of reseeding from saved history each time. (#178955; fixes #178953) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @RomneyDa.
- Model catalogs: honor a configured primary account pin when deciding model readiness, so native Claude CLI models no longer appear as missing auth when the selected token profile is ready. (#178522; related #178502) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @RomneyDa, and @eduardonunesfreire-rgb.
- Backup and restore: preserve supported legacy exec-approval allowlists when sanitizing snapshots instead of replacing them with deny-all; malformed policies remain fail-closed. (#164297) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @cristianoc, and @brucemccurdy.
- Linux companion: persist each saved Gateway dashboard's private browser identity across restarts, while removing storage for deleted Gateways so re-added endpoints pair as fresh devices. (#158908) Thanks @dor-sr, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- Agent database lifecycle: keep peer readers and borrowers alive when maintenance or PostgreSQL opening is refused, preserve the original refusal and clean-restart seal, and retain pre-dispatch recovery behavior when a worker generation disappears. (#175987, #163258, #179320) Thanks @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, @brucemccurdy, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
- macOS bundled Gateway: show the actual installed Gateway version, keep failed or incomplete recovery actionable, and prevent stale or pending update receipts from blocking a valid repair. (#181389) Thanks @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- Model refresh: let explicit catalog refreshes use their existing extended discovery budget through HTTP acquisition while ordinary preparation remains bounded. (#177313) Thanks @jlapenna and @RomneyDa.
- Webhooks and scheduled scripts: classify trusted immediate producers as events, retain each webhook's own automation scope, and refresh disposed script hooks before execution without replaying completed effects. (#172775, #177825, #178904) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jlapenna, and @jalehman.
- Runtime security: backport patched embedded runtimes to the 2026.10.10 line. (#181074) Thanks @RomneyDa and @joshavant.
- Update finalization: keep a verified healthy target successful when a recognized late restart-health or legacy-wrapper maintenance step fails, while authority, data-at-risk, deferred-admission, and unknown failures remain fatal. (#181166; fixes #181020) Thanks @najef1979-code.
- Package update recovery: automatically settle verified interrupted publications or retire untouched preparations, preserve the installed candidate and original Gateway recovery evidence, and keep live update ownership and restart authority fenced. (#181307; fixes #181235) Thanks @agroman1993.
- CLI config writes and setup with a running Gateway: `openclaw config set`, `config unset`, and `openclaw setup` now send their change through the running Gateway as one `config.patch` instead of refusing, with the same result as an offline write, no restart while reload is off, and a success acknowledgement when the Gateway accepts a restart, so Windows companion setup completes again. (#182951, #184194, #184392, #184532, #185109) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Codex native subagents: unblock parent replies after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups; stop resurrecting undeliverable child completions; replay completed grandchildren correctly after Gateway restarts; keep native tool declarations across completion turns; and let Stop succeed after parent thread reuse. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179050, #179099, #183286, #181475; fixes #178395) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @mmartoccia, @wtfichigo, @Marvinthebored, and @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI: stop prompt-cache prefix churn after a child completion. (#172026) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @VACInc.
- Scheduled runs: wait for tool results before answering, so cron run summaries report the real result instead of a premature "no results" reply. (#179690) Thanks @obviyus.
- Agent restart recovery: release restart-recovery fences for killed runs so their conversations no longer stay blocked. (#181992; fixes #181952) Thanks @najef1979-code.
- Windows exec: restore command execution for Gateways running as an S4U scheduled task when Store PowerShell is installed. (#182898; fixes #182652) Thanks @RomneyDa and @tre1d.
- Kimi: give Kimi K3.1 Pro the K3 thinking and video controls. (#181923) Thanks @obviyus.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.3..ed2b311521579d51523c9e31f1c326310e2c2922 history: 60 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 60 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.8

### Highlights

- **Updates that finish and recover:** an ordinary post-update Doctor failure restarts the Gateway instead of leaving it stopped, an orphaned maintenance worker no longer blocks every CLI command and Gateway start, and updates no longer abort on ACL filesystems, Windows pnpm optional-dependency links, pnpm 10 global installs, debug console logging, or a missing legacy OAuth directory. (#180668, #181695, #181141, #181596, #181456, #182850, #180174) Thanks @hannesrudolph, @SMF12138, @rayluo88, @PonySlayer28, and @VN77-77VN.
- **Gateway service installs on every desktop:** macOS recovers a loaded launchd registration whose plist was deleted, Linux installs under the Ubuntu default umask create a private state directory instead of being refused, and the macOS updater waits for the serving Gateway to release its databases before Doctor runs. (#180390, #179538, #182055) Thanks @avnishkirnalli and @XiaoPengYouCode.
- **Conversations keep accepting messages:** killed runs release their restart-recovery fence, interrupted and just-accepted child sessions recover after a Gateway restart, inbound messages stop retrying forever when the reply runtime cannot publish, and the Control UI forgotten-send retry delivers the reply instead of an authoring error. (#181992, #178888, #181871, #181300, #182219) Thanks @najef1979-code, @handcraftrc-pixel, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
- **Startup and database resilience:** startup work no longer inherits a closed SQLite reader scope, so models, chat metadata and channel replies stay available; transient lock contention during agent database startup is retried; and model catalogs stay available during skill runs. (#182615, #182446, #182385)
- **Security hardening:** exec allowlist mode requires approval for `test -v` operand expansion, generic node invoke refuses browser proxy commands, sandboxed spawned children cannot run host CLI backends, the secret egress proxy rejects distrusted eMudhra chains, Fish Audio and Gradium errors no longer expose API keys, and deeply nested Tlon content can no longer stall the channel. (#180880, #179880, #178742, #179249, #178877, #177536) Thanks @eleqtrizit and @joshavant.
- **Windows exec and plugins:** agent exec works under S4U scheduled tasks while Store PowerShell is installed, native plugins load on machines with Endpoint DLP, and Doctor recovers dangling dependency junctions and plugins on another filesystem. (#182898, #179949, #179549, #179445) Fixes #182652 Thanks @RomneyDa, @tre1d, @coaiMax, @paulcam206, @JIRBOY, and @ceckert.
- **Provider and model continuity:** Codex turns keep their budget with older runtime plugins instead of silently falling back, Codex native child inference works after startup, OpenAI OAuth works with stale catalogs, Anthropic PDF analysis works with setup-token OAuth, a timed-out MCP session close no longer fails the next turn, and CLI history owner changes stop instead of silently replaying on another provider. (#182995, #176311, #181356, #178420, #182189, #180075) Fixes #181619 Thanks @RomneyDa, @kip-claw, @enki, @sasan1200, @sunlit-deng, @khensthoth, @aniketkrs, @goslingmanagment, @wr-web, and @teddashh.

### Changes

- **Fresh OpenAI setup:** first-run model metadata no longer restricts the model picker to one model. (#175945) Thanks @matthematics1137 and @jb-dev1.

### Fixes

- **Channel accounts:** default Slack, Google Chat, X, Nextcloud Talk and Zalo accounts keep starting and keep their secrets after a named account is added. (#176267, #180450, #182608) Thanks @555aaditya, @progerjkd, and @masatohoshino.
- **Slack:** an isolated `invalid_auth` is retried before a socket-mode channel is disabled, and silent relay network drops reconnect. (#181056, #182368) Thanks @mushuiyu886 and @marns.
- **Matrix, Twitch, Zalo, iMessage and Feishu delivery:** ordinary Matrix messages are no longer treated as text commands, Twitch sends normalize channel targets, Zalo DMs with URLs are handled, iMessage recovers after the Messages bridge dies, and Feishu quick-action cards send again. (#179506, #178480, #178938, #180900, #79832) Thanks @xiaopan-xydt, @doomy, @HeZ2z, @Takhoffman, @zzrs-xxxr, @namchamvinhcuu, and @xiabee.
- **Agent runs and providers:** heartbeat loops stop when background commands finish, temporary Codex probe workers no longer accumulate, Codex native turns stay alive during host work, Claude CLI turns no longer stall 15 minutes when stream output hits its limit, provider stream errors surface immediately, and session admission races no longer trigger model fallback. (#179060, #167390, #181839, #159931, #117397, #179347) Fixes #178937, #181805, and #178000 Thanks @maxdjohnson, @sunlit-deng, @Terwox, @AINCHORS, @robertmsale, and @davidcittadini.
- **Voice and meetings:** Discord realtime voice consults initialize their runtime, voice calls use the configured agent model, and long meeting talk-back replies keep their audio. (#179462, #181451, #178254) Thanks @shoaibulhaque, @yagizkus, @potoior, @BeyonceBot, and @sukhdeepjohar.
- **Remote access and history:** Tailscale Serve and Funnel recover after tailscaled restarts, and cron history stays readable after provider changes. (#180081, #181311) Thanks @enki, @saariuslystoned, and @xtimor.
- **Doctor repairs:** retained transcripts verify after heading repairs, and repair keeps the Codex host compaction model. (#179089, #179914) Thanks @mrsavingsblogspot-rgb and @LiuwqGit.
- **Plugins and nodes:** older plugin debounce callbacks keep working, computer use accepts input results from older Mac nodes, and Memory Wiki keeps user Notes when OKF concepts disappear. (#118011, #137755, #179657)
- **Secrets and hooks:** the 1Password secret provider accepts group-writable OpenClaw files, and concurrent session-memory captures no longer overwrite each other. (#181127, #181081) Thanks @jalehman, @jason-allen-oneal, and @yetval.
- **Doctor recovery messages:** when Doctor cannot restore a Gateway it stopped, it prints the failure and how to start the Gateway. (#181941)
- **Codex native children and replies:** completed or undeliverable child completions no longer replay or wedge parents, replies unblock after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups, final answers survive transient retries, settled turns without a mirrored prompt finalize, native tool declarations stay stable, queued chats recover after plugin reloads, submitted steering commits before terminal release, and Codex accepts managed loopback proxy defaults. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179099, #179050, #183286, #181779, #183077, #182104, #184062, #183232) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @wtfichigo, @mmartoccia, @Marvinthebored, @sukhdeepjohar, @jjjhenriksen, @aatreya, @ermaxinc, and @RomneyDa.
- **Claude CLI sessions:** unrelated native tasks no longer hold the final answer, parent replies finish after nested background agents, a stopped first turn keeps its conversation, room events no longer reset sessions, operators can keep native Agent and Workflow tools, resumed sessions see conversation updates, and Claude CLI models stay available with saved subscriptions. (#170322, #182267, #181966, #182273, #183765, #183059, #179203) Thanks @cassthebandit, @VACInc, @goslingmanagment, @holgergruenhagen, @xiaopan-xydt, @Marvinthebored, @scarabone, @atomsmasher81, @josh-cornelius, and @teddashh.
- **Subagents and agent turns:** model fallback stops after local runtime faults, recovered child results deliver after session reuse, private completion receipts reconcile after a restart, parents keep waiting for active collectors, batched tool calls settle before `sessions_yield`, delayed `sessions_send` replies are no longer cut at 4,096 characters, turns finish after tool-result recovery, messages sent during transcript rebuilds are recovered, and completed attempt callbacks are released. (#180042, #184069, #184041, #172959, #184021, #178271, #175685, #182666, #164843, #183884) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @danielsiemers, @johan-eilertsen, @jailbirt, @rjdotdev, @wr-web, @seriouslysean, @MSNexploder, and @PollyBot13.
- **Gateway stability and streaming:** long HTML and JSX answers, crafted Teams HTML, and replies that look like tool calls no longer stall the Gateway; reasoning tags are withheld before streaming; silent turns no longer send rich payloads; channel restarts survive exited-run cancellation; the Gateway closes after forced plugin retirement; plugin service schedules outlive the scope that created them; and cold tool inventories no longer grow memory. (#175472, #183438, #183252, #182454, #129244, #182433, #181270, #182207, #178596) Thanks @JasonBuildAI, @LeizhenZhang, @zax0rz, @JOY, @0xtc23, @bguliano, @obviyus, and @wuqxuan.
- **Updates, installs and Doctor:** Windows managed updates no longer lock themselves on TEMP aliases, the Windows installer runs through `iex`, updates complete during channel outages and keep accepted policy pins, stopped database backups allow readers, Doctor restores the Gateway after SIGHUP, keeps valid reseeded configs and inherited logins, repairs unsupported Node runtimes, recovers agents after deletion journal loss, restores plugin host links, handles very large retained histories, and uses less memory on large fleets. (#183622, #183145, #179471, #180505, #180827, #182901, #183703, #179726, #181618, #181804, #181140, #180414, #180792, #181465) Thanks @ryandle, @duyufansh2008, @waynegault, @csabatatrai, @samueltardieu, @4140leal-cw, @rybing7, @RomneyDa, @LiuwqGit, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
- **Sessions and storage:** relative session stores resolve against the state directory, sessions archive through symlinked state paths, stale restart-recovery sources no longer wedge sessions, cron cleanup keeps live child sessions, archived Discord slash-command sessions restore in place, background plugin work keeps its SQLite reader, and session deletes reuse warm archive workers. (#182444, #181554, #180853, #179057, #168596, #179031, #171156, #175091, #183410) Thanks @erickj92, @Cloud-Ocean, @Oldrich333, and @PollyBot13.
- **Auth and providers:** rate-limited profiles cool down only as long as the provider asks, shared OAuth refreshes past deleted peers, concurrent agents keep MCP tool access while an OAuth credential is leased, utility models no longer return thinking-only replies, custom GLM providers generate session titles, Kimi K3.1 Pro gets the K3 thinking and video controls, Bedrock Mantle GPT models route through Responses, Google streams recover, and native conversations survive a compaction fallback model. (#180280, #179205, #179997, #169920, #172580, #181923, #182437, #117194, #183282) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @WG-Mojo, @maliv2, @danielsiemers, @jacobtomlinson, @TommyLei666, @obviyus, @rayvader, and @pstarkgit.
- **Channels:** Telegram and Mattermost default accounts keep their tokens after a named account is added, X accounts with capitalized keys can be managed and synced, iMessage stops answering its own self-chat replies, Feishu keeps streamed text across tool calls, Google Chat delivers remote attachments as links, Synology Chat stops reporting false delivery failures, Tlon recovers after network drops, and channel images a turn could not read are retried. (#183618, #182706, #183263, #183461, #183383, #182438, #182416, #177654, #178358, #183390) Thanks @555aaditya, @rodricksz4h5, @wangmiao0668000666, @nxmxbbd, @sukhdeepjohar, @felirami, @kentuscn, @jailbirt, @HootRock, @masatohoshino, @yetval, and @teddashh.
- **Voice, apps and browser:** realtime Talk survives early output and brief Gateway stalls, GPT-Live Talk and Bun realtime voice use the managed proxy, oversized macOS recordings error instead of disconnecting the node, Android chat binds to an allowed agent, the Tauri app no longer crashes before the dashboard is ready, FaceTime accepts new calls after a disconnect, the Control UI detects dead Gateway links, and browser control no longer rewrites trusted-proxy Gateway auth or holds profile leases after timeouts. (#182919, #180572, #175886, #176567, #182593, #182767, #183841, #154230, #179101, #181620, #154246) Thanks @anmol0b, @StatsR4Losers, @kybrcore, @MertBasar0, @jalehman, @CheatosBu, @xiaopan-xydt, @dawidkulpa, @Solvely-Colin, @fuller-stack-dev, and @LLagoon3.
- **Config, cron and workspaces:** Control UI saves accept fully masked SecretRefs, short session URLs with navigation hints load, cron jobs keep running after sending to their own target and after a hook plugin is replaced, provisioned workspaces work without templates, Windows workspace sync no longer fails before lease acquisition, trusted-proxy readiness probes succeed without forwarded headers, and restart-recovery notices no longer claim a Gateway restart. (#183571, #183148, #177518, #177825, #120943, #183064, #182823, #172843) Thanks @lonexreb, @Valkster70, @xiaopan-xydt, @2991495215, @masatohoshino, @jlapenna, @shakkernerd, @ericcaiwx-star, @treez-admin, and @obviyus.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.7..fdd5997b8fa1c0b69159adcadd1d6ca191416e09 history: 162 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 162 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.9.35
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.7)

## 2026.9.35

### Highlights

- **Steadier memory under service managers:** worker heap caps now apply even when the Gateway service passes a process-wide `--max-old-space-size`, idle Codex app-server clients retire after 30 seconds, and archive workers are reused between session deletes, so long-running Gateways stop accumulating memory. Fixes #179515, #169797, #165663. (#166581, #171490, #168387, #171156, #175091) Thanks @valkyriweb and @RomneyDa.
- **Updates finish more often:** update-time Doctor now removes leftover unknown config keys after migrations, accepts a missing legacy OAuth directory, keeps a valid config that lacks `meta`, settles a completed package publication that already serves the candidate, and no longer overflows on very large session histories. Fixes #174618, #183479. (#175404, #180174, #183703, #180414)
- **Gateway stays responsive:** crafted Microsoft Teams HTML, replies shaped like tool calls, and long streamed HTML or JSX answers no longer stall the Gateway event loop for seconds at a time. (#183438, #183252, #174833, #175472, #180765) Thanks @LeizhenZhang and @JasonBuildAI.
- **Replies reach the user:** the message tool stays directly visible under Tool Search, model fallback works after an unexecuted tool call and for compaction, timed-out MCP sessions no longer break the next turn, and Claude CLI turns that hit the output limit fail fast instead of stalling for 15 minutes. Fixes #176045. (#179450, #183282, #182189, #159931) Thanks @hehuang139, @pstarkgit, @aniketkrs, and @Terwox.
- **Codex native subagents settle correctly:** parents are no longer blocked after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete a follow-up; undeliverable completions are not resurrected; and completed grandchildren no longer replay after a Gateway restart. (#173018, #175246, #179050, #179099, #177577, #181839) Thanks @quqi1599, @wtfichigo, @linancn, and @sunlit-deng.
- **Safer by default:** `test -v` exec operands now require approval in allowlist mode, browser proxy commands are refused through generic node invoke, generated-video downloads use the SSRF guard, and `openclaw mcp list`/`show` plus logs redact credentials. (#180880, #179880, #182425, #180321, #183193) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @brandon-julio-t, and @LeizhenZhang.
- **SQLite 3.54 data safety:** Doctor and update snapshots now repair stale full-text indexes left by the SQLite tokenizer change instead of quarantining agent databases. Fixes #176220. (#176234, #181206)

### Changes

- **Kimi K3.1 Pro:** `moonshot/kimi-k3.1-pro`, `kimi/k3.1-pro`, and their Highspeed variants get the K3 thinking, effort, and video controls; K3.1 rejects `off` locally instead of returning a provider 400. (#181923) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Known-issue documentation:** documented the `--preserve-symlinks` plugin capture workaround, the 2026.8.35 updater's schema warning, and recovery after a publication-journal device-number change. Related #175591, #170031. (#184143) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Credential and content boundaries:** require approval for `test`/`[` `-v` operands, refuse browser proxy commands on generic node invoke, guard generated-video downloads, redact MCP inspection output and Google OAuth client secrets, keep commentary out of turns whose replies are disabled, and keep private media out of silent turns. (#180880, #179880, #182425, #180321, #183193, #178518, #129244) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @brandon-julio-t, @LeizhenZhang, and @obviyus.
- **Reply delivery and fallback:** keep the message tool visible under Tool Search, allow model fallback after unexecuted tool calls and for compaction, fall back immediately on exhausted Anthropic usage caps, recover unfinished tool work after empty `length` stops, and keep rejected Claude CLI drafts out of final replies. Fixes #176045, #176179. (#169091, #179450, #183282, #176186, #153728, #168764) Thanks @hehuang139, @pstarkgit, @sunlit-deng, @zhangguiping-xydt, and @ruel225.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** bound regex and tag scans for Microsoft Teams HTML, tool-call-shaped replies, and long streamed markup. (#183438, #183252, #174833, #175472, #180765) Thanks @LeizhenZhang and @JasonBuildAI.
- **Claude CLI sessions:** ignore request echoes when checking for orphaned tool calls, classify rejected resume checkpoints as an expired session, end output-limit stalls promptly, and stop announce wakes from resetting CLI chats. (#172026, #159931, #181308, #176218) Thanks @Terwox, @mushuiyu886, and @eliavb43.
- **Agent runtime:** release completed attempt callbacks, finish parent handoff after cancelling child tasks, cap large subagent completion batches, preserve memory captures during concurrent session resets, load skills when macOS workspace casing differs, and stop thinking-only replies from utility models, including custom GLM title models. (#183884, #178893, #172068, #181081, #181236, #169920, #172580) Thanks @brianmcguire and @jason-allen-oneal.
- **Codex:** retire idle unowned app-server clients, keep native tool declarations stable on completion turns, keep native liveness during host work, and settle native subagent completions, interruptions, follow-ups, and restart replay. Fixes #165663. (#168387, #183286, #181839, #173018, #175246, #179050, #179099, #177577) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @quqi1599, @wtfichigo, and @linancn.
- **Channels:** recover Slack socket mode from an isolated `invalid_auth` and Slack relay connections from silent network drops, tag only Matrix control commands with a command source, keep Telegram offset checkpoints working on Bun, keep the realtime voice transport runtime for callbacks, and keep channel accounts restarting after an exited run is cancelled. Fixes #179398. (#181056, #182368, #179506, #178909, #179462, #182433) Thanks @mushuiyu886, @xiaopan-xydt, @brianmcguire, and @shoaibulhaque.
- **MCP and GitHub tools:** let concurrent agents read a fresh shared MCP OAuth credential without the exclusive lease, and accept GitHub PR publishing from operators whose profile attaches after connect. (#179997, #169400) Thanks @maliv2 and @Gigaxel.
- **Gateway, state, and readiness:** answer trusted-proxy readiness probes without forwarded headers, bound channel-identity admission waits so stalled admission cannot pin WAL checkpoints, keep queued startup work off temporary SQLite reader scopes, avoid writer stalls during initial host admission, preserve live state-lock owners while recovering stale Linux locks, and finish worker shutdown after inventory retirement. Related #143524. (#182823, #172244, #182615, #171549, #175118, #168862) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @xialonglee, and @xiaopan-xydt.
- **Update, install, and Doctor:** remove unowned config keys during updates, accept a missing legacy OAuth directory, keep a valid config that lacks `meta`, route debug logs off JSON stdout during admission, bound the post-activation Doctor step and update baseline checks, recover the Node runtime when started from `/`, accept unchanged dist files with extra execute bits, tolerate absent optional packages in Windows swaps, launch SQLite helpers hidden on Windows, create the state directory `0700` regardless of umask, admit group-writable plugin secret resolvers, allow SQLite readers during stopped backups, import transcripts whose filename differs from the header, read cron history identities before payloads, avoid stack overflow on very large session histories, settle a completed package publication that already serves the candidate, and refuse a registry update before staging when the Gateway's Node does not satisfy the target's `engines.node` instead of crash-looping after the switch. Fixes #174618, #183479, #183149. (#180769, #175404, #180174, #183703, #182850, #173862, #181906, #178112, #181141, #181596, #174969, #179538, #181127, #180827, #178146, #174530, #180414) Thanks @jalehman and @wangmiao0668000666.
- **Plugins:** replace dangling dependency junctions instead of refusing plugin migration, copy native captures across filesystems, and tolerate ctime-only stat drift in native companion admission. (#179549, #179445, #179949) Thanks @coaiMax.
- **SQLite full-text indexes:** repair stale FTS indexes after the SQLite 3.54 tokenizer change in Doctor and update snapshots instead of quarantining agent data. Fixes #176220. (#176234, #181206)
- **Release validation compatibility:** carry the release-retrospective batch 5 tooling (admission pins, compact reuse plans, Plugin SDK revision rendering) needed by current full-release validation. (#181920) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

The 2026.9.35 maintenance audit covers all 3,595 `main` commits from
`beaee570a5d4` (2026-10-21) through `f227543e4815`, plus open P0/P1 issues and
operator-requested PRs. 78 fixes from 77 numbered PRs and 3 branch-specific
repairs were applied or adapted; the rest were classified as not affected,
already covered, or excluded with a reason.

The complete PR inventory, adaptations, exclusions, and corrections to the
2026.9.34 audit are preserved in the
[2026.9.35 extended-stable backport audit](../docs/releases/2026.9.35-backport-audit.md).
The grouped notes above remain the user-impact summary.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.7

### Highlights

- **Replay-safe session recovery:** interrupted sessions now retain recovery provenance and unfinished tool outcomes, stopped conversations retire terminal recovery residue before accepting the next message, rejected Claude CLI drafts stay out of final replies, large child-completion batches stay within requester context, and Codex previews no longer block replies after a context refresh. (#153728, #168764, #172068, #177716, #176682, #176783, #176675, #159715, #181801) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @ruel225, @Oliver4Spot, @jjjhenriksen, @enki, @PennyVibe, @mbelinky, @RomneyDa, and @krjcolby-svg.
- **Safer update activation and recovery:** verified activations remain successful through later maintenance or ledger errors, interrupted package updates resume safely, post-activation Doctor waits are bounded, stale receipts cannot veto a valid repair, and Windows deep or 8.3 state paths no longer abort onboarding or migration. (#181166, #181307, #173862, #167459, #172768, #172769, #181389) Thanks @najef1979-code, @agroman1993, @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- **Database and worker continuity:** maintenance refusals preserve peer readers and borrowers, incompatible retained agent databases stay isolated, empty transcript deletions skip unnecessary archive materialization, Bun admission deadlines remain thread-local, and worker shutdown completes after inventory retirement. (#175987, #179320, #170122, #171372, #172756, #168862) Thanks @LifeViwer, @Captain69G, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- **Backup and state durability:** snapshots retain supported legacy exec-approval policies, interrupted R2 verification and restores resume safely, config observation keeps the last-known-good snapshot during truncated writes, failed multi-file patches preserve earlier files, and Memory Wiki re-imports preserve human-authored notes. (#164297, #171292, #152565, #160409, #175707) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @davidcittadini, @LiuwqGit, @yetval, @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @cristianoc, and @brucemccurdy.
- **Operator control continuity:** native computer control recovers after session expiry, late-attached GitHub operators can publish PRs, synchronous node output is not duplicated as a completion wake, cron announcements preserve CLI chats, and history maintenance reads identities before payloads. (#169385, #169400, #164511, #176218, #174530) Thanks @stackingrockss, @Gigaxel, @holgergruenhagen, @eliavb43, @wangmiao0668000666, @asikorskiy, and @RomneyDa.
- **Provider and plugin continuity:** model refresh, configured-account readiness, GPT-5.6 tool turns, OpenRouter onboarding, incremental plugin loading, and faster external TypeScript plugin startup retain current state instead of rejecting valid setup or discarding providers. (#176709, #178522, #173366, #173292, #162226, #161267, #168391) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @eduardonunesfreire-rgb, @chandraveshchaudhari, @netcrazed, @obviyus, @jakeaadams, and @RomneyDa.
- **Managed integration reliability:** saved Linux Gateway dashboards preserve pairing across restarts, slow macOS Talk runs retain their replies, app upgrades converge official plugins, Copilot setup verifies SDK-backed agents correctly, Claude CLI cache prefixes stay stable after child completion and retain context when caller-only tools appear or disappear, and passkey prompts no longer block headless browser clicks. (#158908, #164485, #174257, #163578, #172026, #178955, #170857) Thanks @dor-sr, @PollyBot13, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @lifuyue, @Marvinthebored, @VACInc, @trukhinyuri, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @wangmiao0668000666, @brucemccurdy, and @rsaeks.
- **Cross-platform app-managed upgrades:** native state repair, recovery snapshots, Gateway runtime admission, and post-upgrade service recovery now converge without losing agent access across macOS and Windows. (#171508, #174297, #175007, #176174, #178155, #178779, #180010, #180576, #180769) Thanks @tjarrau-dev, @DonnieFi, @jayzhou2309, @lostsock1, @sglion777, @Almost-Certified-ops, @billpang1-sketch, and @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Google models:** add Gemini 4 Argon support. (#171852) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Update guidance:** avoid irrelevant database-repair advice when a package manager is missing, and remove superseded warnings after a successful update. (#173293, #173395) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @sunlit-deng, and @bhedanikhilkumar-code.
- **macOS onboarding:** allow fresh profiles to start the Gateway and complete automatic setup. (#173246) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway logging:** prevent a deleted or stale temporary log directory from wedging the Gateway at full CPU during date rollover. (#160433) Fixes #130807 Thanks @masatohoshino, @WadeOwenWatts, and @RomneyDa.
- **Control UI queue state:** clear slash-steer chips after the queued command is consumed. (#180024) Thanks @RomneyDa.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.9.34
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.6)

## 2026.9.34

### Highlights

- **Safer agent file edits:** `apply_patch` now validates an ordered envelope before mutating the workspace, so a later invalid hunk cannot delete files changed by an earlier operation. (#160409) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **More reliable managed upgrades:** app-owned updates now converge official plugins alongside core and retain repair diagnostics. Fixes #174120. (#174257) Thanks @kazuyuki-eguchi and @RomneyDa.
- **Memory Wiki data safety:** OKF concept re-imports now preserve human-authored notes. Fixes #175700. (#175707) Thanks @YangManBOBO and @RomneyDa.
- **Reliable model startup and selection:** Gateway startup now survives model-refresh ownership replacement, and catalog readiness honors the effective primary model's configured account pin. Fixes #178502. (#173366, #178522) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @eduardonunesfreire-rgb, and @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway and integration stability:** log rotation no longer spins on a deleted `/tmp`, Buzz relay closure no longer exits the Gateway during authentication, and OpenRouter onboarding accepts valid credentials. Fixes #147269. (#160433, #170591, #173292) Thanks @masatohoshino, @jarvis-modern-mail, @chandraveshchaudhari, @RomneyDa, and @WadeOwenWatts.
- **Plugin hooks restored:** `before_tool_call` hooks now run under `openclaw agent exec`. Fixes #158824. (#159333) Thanks @joseairosa and @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Managed update convergence:** official plugins are reconciled to the app-managed core version during upgrades, with diagnostics retained for repair paths. Fixes #174120. (#174257) Thanks @kazuyuki-eguchi and @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Agent patch atomicity:** preflight ordered `apply_patch` envelopes before mutation so later invalid hunks cannot destroy earlier files. (#160409) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
- **Memory Wiki note preservation:** retain human-authored notes when OKF concepts are imported again. Fixes #175700. (#175707) Thanks @YangManBOBO and @RomneyDa.
- **Model lifecycle and auth selection:** keep startup alive through model-refresh replacement and honor the configured primary account pin during catalog readiness. Fixes #178502. (#173366, #178522) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @eduardonunesfreire-rgb, and @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway logging and Buzz stability:** avoid deleted-log-target CPU spin and prevent NIP-42 relay closure from exiting the Gateway. Fixes #147269. (#160433, #170591) Thanks @masatohoshino, @jarvis-modern-mail, @RomneyDa, and @WadeOwenWatts.
- **OpenRouter onboarding:** accept valid API keys during route verification. (#173292) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @RomneyDa.
- **Agent plugin hooks:** restore `before_tool_call` execution for `openclaw agent exec`. Fixes #158824. (#159333) Thanks @joseairosa and @RomneyDa.
- **Cross-release updater compatibility:** retain the 2026.10.1 launchd observation and updater runtime exports during extended-stable replacement, and conservatively refuse immutable-install mutation on this older release line. (#160663) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Patched Node runtime floors:** require Node `>=24.22.1 <25 || >=26.12.1` across install, update, Docker images, and the macOS app runtime check, so upgrades refuse vulnerable runtimes with a clear next step. (#181073) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Dependency advisories:** patch `zod` (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5), `body-parser`, and other production advisories on this release line. (#181341) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Session durability:** skip empty transcript archive materialization and fence the first creation during transcript reconciliation. (#170122) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Claude CLI session continuity:** subagent completions no longer reset the Claude CLI session and lose prior context. (#178955) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @RomneyDa.
- **Update recovery:** complete interrupted update recovery safely and preserve admission interruption reasons for Doctor follow-up. (#181503, #181870) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Backup, Linux, and macOS repairs:** carry backup and platform service repairs needed by this release line, including the legacy macOS Gateway status path. (#181466) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Release validation compatibility:** reconcile branch-native update admission, declaration surfaces, safety baselines, and test fixtures required by the current full-release validation toolchain. (#180988) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

The expanded maintenance audit covers all 743 selected source rows from the
2026.10 stable and beta release lines after `v2026.9.33`: 596 unique numbered
PRs and 105 unnumbered release companions. The final source-row dispositions
are 142 applied, 82 branch-adapted, 128 already covered, and 391 explicitly
excluded.

The complete deduplicated PR inventory, mixed source-row sequences, unnumbered
companions, and exclusion reasons are preserved in the
[2026.9.34 extended-stable backport audit](../docs/releases/2026.9.34-backport-audit.md).
The grouped notes above remain the user-impact summary rather than repeating
the hundreds-row audit.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.6
releases.body:
## 2026.10.6

### Highlights

- **Patched Node runtime required:** OpenClaw now requires Node 24.22.1+ on the 24 line or 26.12.1+ on the 26 line, which reject TLS chains signed with the compromised certificate keys addressed in the October 2026 Node.js security releases. Docker images ship Node 24.22.1, installers select the patched runtimes, and `openclaw update` refuses with recovery guidance before installing on an older Node instead of breaking the running install. Source builds now pin pnpm 12.15.0. (#179992) Thanks @joshavant.
- **Safer updates and recovery:** package swaps now refuse unsafe service states, Windows and macOS package-manager updates recover from platform-specific failures, and frozen Gateway startup owners can be retired cleanly. (#171101, #170940, #171936, #171678) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @stop-time, @AntaresGG, and @TommyLei666.
- **Data-preserving migrations and backups:** Doctor and migration paths now refuse malformed or lossy workspace imports, preserve malformed Notes bytes, reject unsafe non-UTF-8 wiki rewrites, keep deeply nested SQLite backups, and retain staging evidence when restore inspection fails. (#172293, #172953, #172742, #174573, #168583, #170867, #172028) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @Leon-SK668, @ericcurtin, @Yolo521-bot, @obviyus, and @altaywtf.
- **Reliable delivery across restarts:** queued turns, watched child results, dead-lettered deliveries, and streamed replies now survive recovery without disappearing, duplicating, or producing false missing-answer notices. (#170384, #169489, #169932, #173798) Thanks @RomneyDa, @huyengiang101086-spec, and @Yolo521-bot.
- **Provider and model resilience:** GPT-5.6 tool turns, OpenRouter DeepSeek tool calls, LM Studio overflow recovery, parallel OpenAI reasoning settings, and model retry/fallback budgets now behave consistently. (#176709, #175058, #169189, #169322, #164808) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Linux2010, @ZhimingQ, @xpeng5278-web, and @anyech.
- **Windows and mobile stability:** fresh Windows state stores, Proxy-backed environments, and stored Anthropic credentials no longer block startup, while iOS Talk and chat connectivity recover from first-reply and timeout failures. (#176174, #176194, #174571, #168416, #169912) Thanks @RomneyDa, @tjarrau-dev, @skyzhao1223, @easyteacher, @scalesmart, @masatohoshino, @Takhoffman, and @Solvely-Colin.
- **Agent and tool-call recovery:** unfinished tools now time out visibly, context overflow compacts after steered tool results, malformed calls continue after earlier refusals, large patch hunks avoid argument-limit crashes, and stopped yielded tasks stay stopped. (#172983, #172019, #170615, #174477, #169453) Thanks @RomneyDa, @budzation, @mirasrael, @r3n3x, @freeqaz-openai, and @obviyus.
- **Channel delivery correctness:** WhatsApp retries and stickers, Telegram albums and dual-stack replies, Slack relay recovery, and Discord voice-call replies no longer lose or duplicate messages. (#142434, #164210, #163926, #171564, #173407, #172380) Thanks @ashawwal, @RomneyDa, @andrewwbuilds, @abacha, @Dat1GUI, @brainmonger, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
- **Worker and worktree recovery:** hosts reclaim worker capacity after reboot, partial-clone worktrees repair missing objects, and child-result and exec-wake evidence survives Gateway restarts. (#168863, #168864, #169489, #169645) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- This patch release contains focused reliability fixes only; it does not introduce new user-facing features.

### Fixes

- **State and system-agent recovery:** restore access to agents held by affected upgrades, recover held system-agent databases after schema changes, and preserve live configuration when forensic snapshots fail. (#175007, #176783, #171217) Thanks @RomneyDa, @PennyVibe, and @Yolo521-bot.
- **Windows state and updates:** canonicalize schema ownership across path aliases, serialize Proxy-backed environments before inspection IPC, hide SQLite helper windows during update work, and recognize native Scheduled Task permission failures in every locale. (#176174, #176194, #174969, #178624) Thanks @RomneyDa, @tjarrau-dev, @skyzhao1223, @easyteacher, and @throwingbones.
- **macOS companion execution:** honor long command and approval deadlines across the companion socket, classify late or lost replies without replaying submitted commands, and preserve native permission details. (#172117) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @RomneyDa, @ylcn91, and @Colton-Harris.
- **Doctor and managed plugins:** repair empty retired-plugin metadata, clear resolved migration warnings, and converge app-managed plugins onto the installed core version. (#173851, #177096, #174257) Thanks @RomneyDa, @fengfan201314-eng, @ScientificProgrammer, @yinx65588-boop, @jj5638521, and @kazuyuki-eguchi.
- **Update diagnostics:** preserve FRV blockers, explain package-journal identity and runtime-retention failures, and avoid cleanup stalls on shared recovery manifests. (#171186, #170385, #169280, #174249) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @astapenkoav, @council10-kera, and @shoaibulhaque.
- **SQLite correctness:** preserve transaction outcomes when warning handlers throw, settle peer closes after shared-worker refusal, and prevent retired cache generations from taking worker ownership. (#157151, #173813, #172798) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- **Reply recovery:** preserve side-question and immediate fallback ordering, avoid repeated or missing answers after streamed delivery, and keep stopped yielded tasks from restarting. (#174869, #169305, #173798, #169453) Thanks @RomneyDa and @freeqaz-openai.
- **Codex and native sessions:** release stalled startup waits and completed subagents after cancellation or cleanup failures, preserve conversations across runtime restarts, keep workspace bindings across reply resets, and settle recovered child binding writes before session readiness. (#168347, #173547, #166368, #160549, #177564) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Kimiyu-186, @alkor2000, @jhgaylor, @vincentkoc, @jjjhenriksen, and @obviyus.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** retain restart custody, avoid stop-time lease deadlocks, recover worker capacity after reboot, and preserve suppressed-channel configuration across reloads. (#172852, #171308, #168863) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **CLI and process diagnostics:** preserve JSON output on Gateway command exits, report resource-disposal and PTY EOF failures, and surface failed diagnostic writes without crashing. (#176795, #173566, #176362, #174622) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- **Scheduled follow-ups:** same-conversation follow-ups scheduled from an authorized operator turn keep that operator's current authority when they run, and one-shot continuations can call `next_check` to check back later. (#176422)
- **Media and TTS:** time out slow hosted speech synthesis and report playback cache, probe, and quota failures rather than silently dropping cleanup errors. (#175614, #175634, #174668) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5..bba7238a1be3a0d4e92c371988f94e81011a06b2 history: 293 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 293 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.3

### Highlights

- Windows reliability: restore fresh state initialization and Gateway startup, hide SQLite helper windows during app updates, and make forced Gateway reinstalls tolerate launcher timestamp settling. (#176194, #174969, #176174, #176945; related #176111, #174906, #176163, and #176872) Thanks @skyzhao1223, @RomneyDa, @easyteacher, @throwingbones, @tjarrau-dev, and @cnnceart.
- Upgrade recovery: converge app-owned plugins to the upgraded core version, restore affected agent stores including held system agents after schema-changing updates, and scope migration rollback backups to the versioned tables being changed. (#174257, #175007, #176783, #172671; related #174120 and #176669) Thanks @RomneyDa, @kazuyuki-eguchi, and @PennyVibe.

### Changes

### Fixes

- Agent state: concurrent initialization can no longer let two agents claim ownership of the same agent database. (#174251)
- Codex and native apps: previews no longer block replies after a context refresh, session replies resume after native child recovery, bound Codex history survives app-server restarts, and native app messages send again after reconnecting. (#177716, #177564, #172705, #171528) Thanks @jjjhenriksen and @RomneyDa.
- Background tasks: completions are no longer dropped when the config changes mid-turn. (#169529; related #169054) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @Oldrich333.
- Discord: restore native slash commands in channels and threads. Thanks @montrellcruse and @RomneyDa.
- Agents: keep the prompt cache when a rate-limited run retries, and preserve steering messages that arrive without an explicit target. Thanks @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
- Cron/CLI continuity: preserve CLI chat sessions across cron announce wakes instead of resetting their provider session. (#176218; related #176208) Thanks @eliavb43 and @RomneyDa.
- CLI tools: invalidate reused CLI sessions when the available tool catalog changes, restoring tools such as `exec` after Gateway restarts and preventing stale catalogs from reaching spawned agents. (#176577; related #175670) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jackylecalvez2, and @vincentkoc.
- GMI: omit unsupported `reasoning_effort` values on GPT-5.6 tool turns so the provider no longer rejects them with HTTP 400. (#176709) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Windows updates: recognize Scheduled Task permission denials in every Windows display language, keep Windows plugin dependency links across Doctor phases, and clean up backup scratch directories without EPERM failures. (#178624, #178219, #169672, #176836; related #176743) Thanks @RomneyDa, @n572770, @xutongxue233, and @WG-Mojo.
- Update and Doctor: update finalization honors `TMPDIR` for disposable copies, Doctor suggests a retry instead of a restore after snapshot contention, and repeated Docker container restarts no longer take a full Doctor pre-repair capture each time. (#178009, #176779, #173711; related #176750 and #173564) Thanks @RomneyDa, @WG-Mojo, and @8bitsforge.
- Memory: cold Gateway starts no longer open every memory index (restoring 2026.10.4 startup memory), memory files keep indexing after plugin reloads, and plugin reloads no longer time out during slow dreaming cleanup. (#174718, #167756, #169945) Thanks @RomneyDa and @Stronggenetics.
- Nodes: synchronous node exec output is no longer repeated as a separate `Exec finished` wake after the waiting caller already received it. (#164511) Thanks @holgergruenhagen and @obviyus.
- macOS: long exec commands through the macOS app node no longer fail after 20 seconds. (#172117; related #139706) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @RomneyDa, @ylcn91, and @Colton-Harris.
- Control UI: offer desktop setup instead of Retry when Host Desktop is off, model pickers refresh when the catalog changes mid-read, and locale refresh works again after adding a source-only locale. (#177888, #174812, #172689; related #174368) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, and @hannesrudolph.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.2..bd1a53a3a5f59a8319112250b48d338d74dbaceb history: 53 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 53 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.2

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Workspace safety: reject a multi-file `apply_patch` before changing files when a later update target is missing or its context does not match, preserving the original workspace for the next attempt. Commit-time I/O failures can still leave partial effects. (#160409; related #117742 and #127496) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @yetval.
- Tool policy: run plugin `before_tool_call` hooks in standalone `openclaw agent exec` sessions so plugin tool guards take effect. (#159333; fixes #158824) Thanks @joseairosa and @obviyus.
- Buzz: reconnect when a relay closes during NIP-42 authentication without terminating the Gateway or interrupting other channels and sessions. (#170591; fixes #147269) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jarvis-modern-mail, and @RomneyDa.
- macOS downloads: save dashboard and conversation attachments through the native Save dialog while keeping the current page open. (#173654) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- OpenRouter onboarding: accept valid API keys with the default `openrouter/auto` model instead of rejecting setup with a route mismatch. (#173292; related #162798) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @obviyus.
- macOS setup: let fresh native profiles start the Gateway and complete automatic setup, including when supervised startup needs a retry. (#173246)
- Gateway startup: follow a replacement model-runtime refresh instead of exiting when initial preparation is superseded. (#173366; related #173357) Thanks @Jackten and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway logging: keep serving and shut down normally when a deleted temporary-directory backing path makes daily log rollover fail. (#160433; fixes #130807) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @WadeOwenWatts, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- Gateway stability: stop session diff capture from opening live SQLite and hard-linked files, preventing SIGBUS crash loops when the shared-memory file is truncated. (#174017)
- Native app updates: let Doctor finish agent database upgrades on native-first profiles instead of reporting success while the Gateway refuses to start on an older schema. (#174297)
- Cron: plan history maintenance from run identities and load full payloads only for rows it updates, so large cron histories no longer exhaust the SQLite worker's memory and take channels down. (#174530; fixes #174078) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @asikorskiy.
- Windows Claude CLI: stop every turn with a stored Anthropic credential from stalling until the no-output watchdog when Claude Code never reads the credential pipe. (#174571; fixes #174204) Thanks @RomneyDa and @scalesmart.
- Plugins: restore the SDK facade exports that published external plugins still import, so those plugins load again. (#173777; fixes #173386) Thanks @RomneyDa and @FtlC-ian.
- Chat tools: keep the chat usable after removing a tool server that failed to start, cleaning up its failed startup before reporting the launch error. (#171397) Thanks @joelagnel.
- Updates: bound the post-activation Doctor step by the update's allowance instead of waiting indefinitely with the Gateway down. (#173862)
- Updates: keep Gateway-managed source updates from failing with missing backup modules after the runtime is replaced. (#173587) Thanks @vishnusenthil-16.
- Updates: make `openclaw update --no-restart` honest for npm, pnpm, and bun installs, which restart themselves after the package is replaced, record the update as successful, and keep a still-serving older build unverified. (#173409, #174649; fixes #171311) Thanks @RomneyDa and @mwbroxson.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.1..f90bd063751f2448330ee6abbb4c894508600d63 history: 24 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 24 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.1
releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Faster, steadier Gateway:** chat turns, session lists, startup, and idle Gateways do far less SQLite and main-thread work, with more database work moved onto worker threads, so busy hosts and large agent fleets stay responsive. (#167965, #168002, #168093, #169005, #169164, #171685, #170151, #169871, #168649, #170612, #171371, #171805, #168992, #169543) Thanks @obviyus, @609NFT, @Leon-SK668, @chelsealong, @RomneyDa, and @joshavant.
- **Updates that finish:** upgrades from 2026.10.1 and earlier betas complete, busy Gateways and slow Doctor steps no longer refuse or roll back a good update, failed updates no longer leave a half-installed version, and macOS, Windows, and Bun installs recover from their platform-specific failures. (#168849, #172249, #172196, #172151, #172247, #171101, #170519, #172640, #171936, #170940, #171077, #172494) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @giulianoaccorsi, @AntaresGG, @stop-time, @davidcittadini, and @SBC2016.
- **Restart-safe replies:** interrupted and unfinished replies resume after a Gateway restart, and watched child results, queued turns, accepted agent updates, and operator tasks survive restarts instead of disappearing. (#172234, #172412, #169489, #171717, #170697, #170858, #170384, #172356, #172023) Thanks @jeanmonet.
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from the session menu, organize cloud environments by repository with environment recipes and verified Node toolchains, and see snapshot progress while sessions start before the first snapshot finishes uploading. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729)
- **Local Gateway in the desktop apps:** the Windows desktop app and fresh Tauri installs can run a local Gateway, fresh macOS installs start in guided dashboard setup, and first-run setup chooses inference automatically. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169628)
- **New models:** Gemini 4 Argon becomes the default Gemini model alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and xAI Imagine Image 2.0 arrive, Meta models run through Muse Code, and pickers stop offering retired models. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170487, #171526, #171879) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, and @obviyus.
- **Newer Apple platforms required:** OpenClaw now requires macOS 26.2, iOS 26.2, and Safari 26.2 or newer. (#168595)

### Changes

- **Apple platform requirement:** require macOS, iOS, and Safari 26.2 or newer for the native apps and Control UI. (#168595)
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from session menus, organize cloud environments by repository, support repository environment recipes with verified Node toolchains, save suggested cloud profiles on first use, show snapshot startup progress, start sessions while the first snapshot uploads, ready workers for empty-workspace sessions, report slow dispatch phases, and keep cloud setup secrets behind scoped egress grants. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729, #170929, #171749, #171073, #170810) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Desktop apps and first run:** support local Gateways in the Windows desktop app, start fresh Tauri installs with a local Gateway, start fresh macOS installs in guided dashboard setup, guide missing native permissions in chat, and choose inference automatically during first-run setup. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169635, #169628)
- **Local setup:** offer optional memory embedding setup, add managed llama.cpp OCR and vision setup, and allow non-interactive llama.cpp embedding-only setup. (#163693, #148193, #170153) Thanks @PollyBot13, @duyufansh2008, and @dh-js.
- **Bun runtime:** build standalone OpenClaw executables with Bun, add an opt-in pinned Bun runtime that rejects unpinnable paths before changing anything, and start the Gateway faster on Bun. (#172384, #168832, #168982, #169543) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Experimental PostgreSQL:** add an experimental PostgreSQL engine for the Workboard store, select the shared-state engine at its owner, generate PostgreSQL DDL from canonical SQLite schemas, add PostgreSQL migrations with capability admission and exact schema-drift checks, preserve PostgreSQL stores in backups and updates, and add verified offline database port tooling. (#169214, #171962, #168219, #169933, #172265, #170828, #170518, #171368, #171265, #170037, #170055, #170059, #171350, #171484, #171518, #171795, #172046, #171545) Thanks @vincentkoc and @joshavant.
- **Conversations:** organize and archive nested conversations explicitly, choose when sessions can send and receive messages, opt in to `sessions_send` thread targets, run sessions in existing folders on paired devices, and snooze sessions until a custom time. (#168076, #162316, #168846, #169722, #171255) Thanks @VACInc, @obviyus, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Session personalization:** personalize session backgrounds, add per-session speech bubbles and prompt reactions, show session-specific previews for public links, and match public conversation pages to the chat design with copy buttons. (#168301, #168861, #169527, #168156) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @VACInc.
- **Control UI navigation:** organize personal navigation in a compact sidebar rail with real shortcut icons, filter sidebar users by online status, keep New conversation visible across sidebar modes, show session details beside wide conversations, make colored sessions easier to scan, inspect attached automations from session hovercards, put everyday session actions first, and make release updates discoverable from the account menu. (#168325, #168997, #172243, #170771, #170707, #170382, #172240, #168616, #172544, #100024) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @shakkernerd, and @VACInc.
- **Control UI chat:** group session context and task progress in Details, clarify the session details inspector, render assistant directives and an embed tag, show readable tweet preview cards, load older history in larger pages, shrink the composer in existing sessions, search emoji by name in the reaction picker, add manual code folding to session diffs, and show or hide values in secure entry prompts. (#161674, #172436, #64104, #168213, #170481, #171637, #172577, #172350, #169925, #172549) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, @Takhoffman, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Languages:** add Swedish to the Control UI and docs, and include plugin catalogs in locale refresh. (#62063, #171496) Thanks @yeager and @vincentkoc.
- **Agents API:** choose Agents API hosted workspaces when starting sessions, isolate Agents API sessions from Gateway tools and MCP, and allow shared compaction tuning in hosted sessions. (#168259, #170728, #171813)
- **MCP apps and automations:** use MCP plugin apps across conversations and workspace files, trigger automations from MCP events, connect MCP apps through a principal-bound relay plugin, and support principal-bound remote Control UI for trusted plugins. (#161747, #165399, #168233, #170540)
- **Plugins and SDK:** allow per-run model fallback overrides, fork a session's live context for background side questions, let plugins steer a session's active run, support Solid Control UI views, add worker-owned keyed state and conversation binding APIs, join service and account scheduling at retirement, complete awaited SQLite compatibility migration paths, and show calm notices for deprecated SDK usage. (#168893, #170146, #170152, #168408, #168478, #168483, #162669, #171443, #171752) Thanks @obviyus, @dwty11, and @joshavant.
- **ClawHub:** expose published ClawHub packages to the Gateway and accept portable manifest categories. (#171622, #171532) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Models and providers:** add Gemini 4 Argon as the default Gemini model with Gemini 3.8 Flash, replace Nemotron 3 Super with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, add xAI Imagine Image 2.0 without silent image-model fallback, accept the Fish Audio Drama 3 preview, support endpoint-resolved custom model aliases, prefer a newer installed Codex for ChatGPT discovery, and prioritize shared private vLLM requests. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170473, #170009, #168228, #129434) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, @xyrolle, @obviyus, @m888m, and @joshavant.
- **Muse Code:** run Meta models through the Muse Code CLI agent runtime, sign in to Muse Code from Model Setup and Provider Access, and run consented turns under a conversation tool policy. (#170487, #171526, #171790, #172361) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Usage and accounts:** show active auth subscription blocks, show Ollama cloud balance in status usage, add a ClawRouter sidebar dashboard for subscription pool headroom, show local provider processing with estimated wait time, and show every matched session in a paged usage overview. (#133087, #167474, #169514, #170041, #170369, #169660) Thanks @Leon-SK668, @vincentkoc, and @usimic.
- **Model recovery:** use model fallbacks after context-overflow recovery, compact ChatGPT sign-in sessions server-side, end runs after confirmed final source replies, and support typed OpenAI Decisions API evaluations. (#170141, #168401, #170653, #166320) Thanks @amirarenco-create, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @sunlit-deng, @jjjhenriksen, and @Kimiyu-186.
- **Labs Advisor:** add an experimental Advisor that steers agents away from avoidable work. (#169564) Thanks @obviyus.
- **CLI progress:** show progress while tool input is generated. (#167789) Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, and @umeranjum17.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.4

### Highlights

- **Updates finish more reliably:** macOS updates no longer time out on aliased temporary directories, systemd user installs reclaim abandoned runtimes, pacman and FreeBSD package installs are left to their package manager, snapshot failures are identified before activation with accurate recovery advice, and the success summary no longer repeats settled plugin upgrades as pending. (#169860, #171488, #169055, #171457, #170351, #170413) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @Pegorim.
- **ChatGPT models work on the default Codex runtime:** ChatGPT-listed models no longer fail before sending any request. (#168033) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Headless browser sign-ins stay usable:** headless pages keep accepting clicks and key presses while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.

### Changes

- **Context limits:** status shows corrected context limits after model discovery, Copilot honors reported context capacity when native limits are missing, and llama.cpp keeps live router model limits and tools on refresh. (#165991, #156636, #168309) Thanks @snotty, @saju01, and @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Gateway access:** local access keeps working when the tailnet denies Tailscale Serve, and lifecycle publications survive after the emitting producer drains. (#171509, #170231) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **macOS repair and recovery:** update recovery finishes repairing the bundled Gateway, the app keeps a compatible newer Gateway during recovery instead of downgrading it, LaunchAgent repair accepts verified bootstrap recovery, and Doctor allows offline state repair for app-owned Gateways. (#171508, #170766, #170740, #170768) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update resilience:** updates keep moving when optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup fails. (#170754) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Security:** Tlon never treats group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Turns and replies:** Claude CLI sessions remember announced sub-agent results on the next turn, agent plugin reloads no longer wait on their own turn, interrupted turns are preserved when new messages arrive, ACP follow-up replies no longer disappear after the previous turn is stopped, context-engine advancement survives steering, visible sub-agent spawns try the primary model first, and launched agent turns no longer fail with writer claim errors. (#164175, #171257, #170647, #170883, #168394, #169984, #170077) Thanks @robertoronderosjr, @RomneyDa, @etzelm, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** the Gateway stays responsive during reply-tagged streams and long quoted tool XML no longer triggers per-token Markdown parsing, blocked context-engine turns stop repeating in the Gateway log on every run, the Control UI no longer reconnects on delayed heartbeats, state reads stay closed until restart after a failed state cleanup, the Gateway recovers state ownership after sleep and clock changes, stalled transcript workers no longer block shutdown, database admission no longer blocks worker startup, shutdown joins lifecycle publication, forced descendant cleanup releases worker capacity, enabled standalone plugin files start with the Gateway, Gateway restart works from verified external macOS terminals, and Android/Termux gateways no longer fail with "shared-state database generation changed". (#166782, #171573, #167595, #171253, #171709, #170790, #170493, #170348, #170555, #168746, #171330, #170354, #167719) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @holgergruenhagen, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @yxshee, @grabowskidaniel359-design, @jjjhenriksen, @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, @Oldrich333, @residentb2b, @boeingchoco, and @jalehman.
- **Workers:** worker heap limits are enforced under process-wide Node flags. (#166581) Thanks @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, and @waynegault.
- **Channels and tools:** MCP OAuth login completes with portless loopback registrations, and each Feishu monitor start gets its own binding adapter registration. (#170876, #169226) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art, @ruel225, @obviyus, and @junniar.
- **Update and Doctor:** update repair no longer fails after Doctor completes on busy macOS hosts, slow update admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, update repair prepares its config before inference, metadata inventory survives progress-output backpressure, Docker upgrades stop retry loops on older Linux hosts, Doctor explains plugin migration backup coverage, and Doctor no longer logs spurious WAL maintenance warnings while repairing shared state. (#170779, #171493, #170276, #168493, #162305, #169295, #170783) Thanks @vincentkoc, @yxshee, @Ludwigtheo0815, @RomneyDa, and @DonnieFi.
- **Plugin publishing:** plugin npm publication no longer fails when artifact pagination repeats an entry. (#171044) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.3..9e0a1c922e978fbcfb14c29d112573f6a99468d7 history: 61 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 61 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.4
releases.body:
## 2026.10.4

### Highlights

- The Gateway keeps running after the computer sleeps or the system clock jumps, instead of restarting itself because its ownership heartbeat looked stale. (#170790) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway shutdown and restart no longer hang on a stalled transcript worker or in-flight session lifecycle events. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Tlon group DMs no longer treat other participants as the owner, closing an owner-impersonation path. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Headless browser pages keep responding to clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Manual `/compact` settles the active run before compacting instead of aborting it and dropping the pending request. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.

### Changes

- Stability patch for 2026.10.3 with no new features or configuration changes. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Gateway: stays responsive during long reply-tagged streams, and long replies that quote tool-call XML no longer re-parse Markdown on every token. (#166782, #171573) Thanks @boeingchoco.
- Gateway: blocked durable context-engine turns are logged once instead of on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- Control UI: delayed application heartbeats no longer force a reconnect. (#171253)
- Gateway: recover state ownership after sleep and wall-clock changes, and allow `openclaw gateway restart` from verified external macOS terminals. (#170790, #170354) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: bound transcript-worker shutdown waits and wait for session lifecycle publication during shutdown. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Gateway: start enabled standalone plugin files with the Gateway, and keep worker heap limits enforced when the managed service sets a process-wide heap flag. (#171330, #166581) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, and @obviyus.
- Agents: launched plugin turns no longer fail with writer-claim errors, and Claude CLI sessions no longer fork history across message routes. (#170077, #167241) Thanks @cmatrx0.
- Agents: manual compaction settles the active run instead of aborting it. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.
- OpenAI: tool turns for reasoning models on api.openai.com Completions routes no longer fail with a 400. (#166182) Thanks @obviyus and @AsTutoAI.
- Updates: agent databases are no longer flagged as changed during snapshot capture, the success summary stops repeating settled plugin data/settings upgrades as pending, and metadata inventory keeps running under progress-output backpressure. (#170351, #170413, #168493) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: slow host admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, progress keeps reporting through temporary Doctor maintenance, snapshot failures get an accurate headline and recovery advice, and Linux updates can clean up abandoned runtime directories under protected systemd user managers. (#171493, #171454, #171457, #171488, #170783, #166335) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: candidate validation no longer amplifies private SQLite snapshots on live installs, older drivers stop reading candidate-migrated state and stale restart verdicts clear, and optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer stall updates. (#167451, #170130, #170754) Thanks @angeliti999 and @RomneyDa.
- Updates: `openclaw update repair` turns no longer time out before running tools on slower hosts; nested authority checks reuse the current state snapshot instead of copying the database again. (#166847)
- Doctor: updates no longer refuse unreferenced retired OAuth sidecars, and offline state repair works for app-owned Gateways. (#165420, #170768) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
- Tailscale: an interrupted start stops its serve process, local access stays available when the tailnet denies Serve, and Doctor checks configured Tailscale startup prerequisites. (#167514, #171509, #166947) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- macOS: app recovery keeps compatible newer Gateways instead of downgrading them, and repair accepts a verified LaunchAgent bootstrap that is already in progress. (#170766, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Sessions: equivalent POSIX path aliases such as `/tmp` and `/private/tmp` no longer restart channels. (#166462) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star.
- MCP: OAuth login completes when the authorization server registers loopback redirect URIs without a port. (#170876) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art.
- Browser: headless pages accept clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Control UI: updated chats recover through the serving document. (#168941)
- Tlon: never treat group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Telegram: polling workers resolve in both source and package builds. (#154286) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui and @markfietje.
- Discord: agent consults keep working after voice changes. (#171029) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star and @brainmonger.
- Feishu: config hot-reload no longer orphans conversation bindings. (#169226) Thanks @ruel225, @junniar, and @obviyus.
- IRC: long non-ASCII replies are no longer lost when the server relays them. (#159730) Thanks @rodricksz4h5.
- Release: plugin npm publish tolerates repeated artifact pagination entries, Linux builds trigger after automatic requests with hosted-runner credentials, and ratchet checks read large Git baselines. (#171044, #167087, #167237, #164743) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.3..d58dd3ceef67f10eab31d93387d2c90866b3ec93 history: 61 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 61 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.
