releases.name: openclaw 2026.9.33
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.3)

## 2026.9.33

### Highlights

- **Safer September upgrades:** updates on the 2026.9 line keep state, plugin data, service ownership, and Windows state paths intact, and refuse automatic restore over unattributed Doctor writes. (#160167, #166755) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @Alix-007, @jayzhou2309, @nitinjwadhawan, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @taihartman, and @DonnieFi.
- **Updates that finish on pnpm, npm, and Windows:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and launchers survive native updates, retained updater runtimes no longer block npm recovery, and Windows updates no longer roll back after Doctor rechecks driver ancestry. (#170003, #170131, #170170, #169563) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **New model support:** run Meta Muse Wonder, use MiniMax M3.1 thinking effort levels, and stay signed in to MiniMax portal OAuth past token expiry. (#170232, #160089, #160459) Thanks @RomneyDa, @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, @rongtianhua, @DonnieFi, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **More reliable model turns:** agent runs honor live thinking levels, local providers get response-header deadlines, ChatGPT WebSocket normal closes recover, and Codex replies keep their final tokens. (#168566, #168282, #167512, #168400) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @ajmtrz.
- **Work survives Gateway restarts:** interrupted automation turns, steered sessions, cloud worker claims, and partial worker replies now resume or persist after a restart. (#170162, #170252, #170161, #170223) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Delivery and device stability:** live sends survive queue recovery, and node requests no longer fail on unrelated pairing activity or while another device's pairing is written. (#169010, #169486, #169575) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Agent and update stability:** carry a broad batch of compatible October fixes for agent turns, sessions, channels, and update recovery. (#170476) Thanks @RomneyDa, @yetval, @Dimitri-lcht, @Program-123, @dhruv1220, @Shenrui-Ma, @igs-rogenlo, @changeroa, @hxy91819, @Takhoffman, @harjothkhara, @TYY-2005, @giodl73-repo, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jalehman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @an2in.

### Changes

- **Meta:** add the Muse Wonder model to the catalog and onboarding with max thinking support, keeping Spark as the default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **MiniMax:** add the MiniMax M3.1 Flash Preview model and route its thinking effort levels to the provider. (#160089) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **LM Studio:** refreshing saved inventory now discovers newly loaded models. (#168039) Thanks @jb-lopez, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

### Fixes

- **Update and Doctor:** keep Doctor running under unreadable supervisors and child binding errors, keep clean service install refusals out of native-authority recovery, stop update history writes from stalling cron and cleanup, avoid bookkeeping-only repair refusals, and never delete an OAuth profile because the legacy auth store is unreadable. (#169665, #169658, #169283, #170195, #170256) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Yolo521-bot, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

(#171816) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** long streamed replies that start with a reply tag such as `[[reply_to_current]]` no longer re-parse the whole reply on every delta, which could keep the Gateway busy for tens of seconds. #166781 (#166782) Thanks @boeingchoco and @obviyus.
- **Tailscale:** an interrupted Tailscale Serve start stops its serve process, the Gateway keeps local access when the tailnet denies Serve, and public chat no longer returns 503s right after startup. #167436 (#167514, #171509, #167604) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- **Context engine:** sessions holding an old blocked turn no longer repeat the blocked-turn warning and re-read it on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- **State database:** state reads no longer stay closed until a Gateway restart after a failed state cleanup. Fixes #162085. (#171709) Thanks @RomneyDa and @residentb2b.
- **Update summaries and Doctor:** successful updates stop listing settled plugin data and settings upgrades as pending, optional dreaming-cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer block updates, and macOS LaunchAgent repair accepts an in-progress bootstrap. (#170413, #170754, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa and @DonnieFi.

- **Channels and tools:** channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account, ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed separately, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and routed turns deliver blocking questions. (#164848, #159396, #164272, #170083, #170039) Thanks @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @ajmtrz, @brokemac79, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @mightyx.
- **Automation:** failed one-shot automations always alert, and cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on host admission. (#169102, #168291) Thanks @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **Release checks:** Windows installer checks tolerate slow `gateway stop` help and surface cleanup errors, packaged checks recover from a busy Gateway port, and extended-stable candidates now qualify upgrades from the previous extended-stable release. (#169567, #170178, #171565) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.5-beta.3
releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.3

### Highlights

- **Updates leave the Gateway running:** pnpm 12 installs keep their Gateway service and `openclaw` launcher on the durable install path, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task accounts and their own verified driver, macOS accepts protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals no longer leave the Gateway stopped. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658, #169915) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, @jokerman1302-eng, and @vincentkoc.
- **Stuck updates recover:** updates settle package-activation journals after filesystem remounts or device-number drift, ride out a briefly locked state database, stop reporting false post-install failures after migration, and reclaim retained updater runtimes that blocked npm recovery. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #168210, #170130, #169422, #170170, #169463) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @angeliti999, and @Warhangel.
- **Doctor keeps credentials and data:** Doctor no longer deletes an OAuth profile when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata, and restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, and @RomneyDa.
- **Turns survive restarts:** interrupted turns, subagent work, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume after a Gateway restart, and streamed replies from a killed worker stay in history. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #170223)
- **Telegram never replays old updates:** the first start after updating no longer re-dispatches months-old Telegram updates from the legacy spool as new owner instructions. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Codex and provider replies complete:** Codex replies keep their last tokens and accept follow-ups after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close, and DeepSeek tool markup no longer leaks into messages. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #169728, #159665) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @mightyx, and @TOMUIV.
- **Meta Muse Wonder:** Meta users can select `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with tools, image input, streaming, reasoning controls, and a 1M-token context window. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2 can import `createSessionHeaderLink` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` again. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Meta Muse Wonder:** adds `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with text and image input, tools, streaming, encrypted reasoning replay, and a 1,048,576-token context window; Spark remains the onboarding default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Device joins:** the CLI and Control UI join command now installs a background node service that can host agent sessions (`--service --session-host`), with a command-only service alternative, and already-paired devices get a working command to enable session hosting. (#168623) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- **Telegram:** legacy spool updates older than 24 hours are imported as stale and never dispatched, so already-handled messages are not executed again after an update. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** `createSessionHeaderLink` is restored in `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` as a deprecated export for plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Reply delivery:** streamed text from a killed native worker stays in history with its real failure, steered messages behind subagent announcements are no longer dropped as interrupted, blocking questions from routed agent turns reach their conversation, live sends survive delivery recovery, WebChat no longer shows false attachment errors or duplicate file cards, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and deleting a session records its cancellation before draining retained replies. (#170223, #168077, #170039, #169010, #169093, #170083) Thanks @RomneyDa and @brokemac79.
- **Restart recovery:** turns interrupted while a session was still preparing resume after a restart, interrupted subagents return to their parent with their history, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume instead of failing with an active turn claim, a Gateway restarts cleanly when a stored cloud worker's machine is gone, and symlinked state directories keep working after a restart. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #168907, #168361) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Nodes and channels:** node requests and events no longer fail with "pairing changed" during another device's pairing activity, and channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account. (#169486, #169575, #159396) Thanks @ceckert and @RomneyDa.
- **macOS app:** fresh app installs authenticate to their app-hosted Gateway and finish setup faster, and the Gateway reconnects automatically after a trusted TLS certificate renewal. (#169403, #168151)
- **Codex and OpenAI:** Codex replies keep their final tokens when a stream drops the last delta, Codex follow-ups work after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close with code 1000, and personal-account quota rechecks no longer abort replies. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #170065) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, and @mightyx.
- **Models and providers:** DeepSeek tool-call markup is recovered instead of leaking into messages, Claude CLI sessions call registered OpenClaw tools by their MCP names, providers that never send response headers time out, agent runs honor the provider's live thinking levels without reloading catalogs, LM Studio refresh discovers new models, llama.cpp setup keeps aliased models and fails when credentials cannot be saved, and guarded model requests fall back to IPv6. (#169728, #159665, #153032, #168282, #168566, #168039, #150262, #168232, #168973, #87763) Thanks @TOMUIV, @kiranvk-2011, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @jb-lopez, @an2in, and @georgenaz.
- **MiniMax:** M3.1 models honor their thinking effort levels, and MiniMax OAuth sign-ins refresh expired tokens instead of failing about two hours after login. (#160089, #160037, #160459, #77467) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, and @rongtianhua.
- **ACP and compaction:** ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed as a separate package, and the next turn after native compaction no longer fails while the transcript projection rebuilds. (#164272, #164211, #169583) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, and @ajmtrz.
- **Automations:** manual runs keep tool access after the starting turn ends, cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on the host so updates do not fail with a locked database, and a one-shot automation that fails terminally now sends a failure notice instead of disabling silently. (#168037, #168291) Thanks @obviyus.
- **pnpm and platform updates:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and `openclaw` launchers stay on the durable install link after updates, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task account names and no longer roll back when Doctor re-checks ancestry, macOS updates accept protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals stay recoverable. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, and @jokerman1302-eng.
- **Update recovery:** package-activation journals settle after filesystem remounts and device-number drift, retained updater runtimes outside `node_modules` are reclaimed and never hard-link recovery files, upgrades keep state ownership across the heartbeat transition, and update-time Doctor keeps its child identities after a failed custody binding. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #170170, #169463, #169915, #169665) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @Warhangel, and @vincentkoc.
- **Update outcomes:** updates with a running Gateway no longer record false post-install failures after migration, unsafe Doctor recovery guidance is kept until settled, candidate bookkeeping no longer makes older updaters refuse their config repair, and Doctor cleanup during updates no longer fails with nested-effect errors. (#170130, #169422, #170207, #170195, #170070, #168750) Thanks @angeliti999, @hannesrudolph, and @ezimerman.
- **Update database contention:** updates ride out a briefly locked state database, update history writes no longer stall Gateway cron and cleanup, and Doctor recovery captures stay stable while shared-state workers remain open. (#168210, #169283, #170022) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps OAuth profiles when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata after archiving legacy session stores, restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails, and removes the `(multiple)` store sentinel registered as an agent database. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783, #170043, #169764) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, @RomneyDa, and @ourcoms2018.
- **oc-path:** `openclaw path set` refuses malformed UTF-8 before writing, preserving the file's bytes. (#168491) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666 and @Takhoffman.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.2..463017d7dfa5fcbcb6fff97f32c17e09267c2b5a history: 71 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 71 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.2

### Highlights

- **Updates finish and recover:** `openclaw update` settles stale handoff leases, completed receipts, and legacy 2026.9.8 recovery records instead of stopping on `update-recovery-pending`, keeps the service heap limit and webhook listeners, handles Windows short-name paths, and no longer reports accepted handoffs or successful updates as failures. (#169038, #169027, #168388, #168889, #169035, #169292, #168927, #168993, #169037, #169454, #168905) Thanks @mkdelta221, @waynegault, @chedong, @k94118, @bluet, @sirius1024, @RomneyDa, @sayitfast, and @hannesrudolph.
- **Doctor keeps your plugins and data:** Doctor preserves installed plugins' configuration when path safety checks block them, leaves malformed UTF-8 root memory files untouched, and recovery copies capture Canvas and Memory Core files before migrations move them, including on installs with no configured agents. (#168111, #169029, #169436, #169516) Thanks @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, and @RomneyDa.
- **Approved tool calls stay as approved:** hooks can no longer change tool arguments after a trusted inline approval; plugins that transform arguments must request approval for their final arguments. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Subagent message provenance:** inter-session messages keep their `[Inter-session message]` safety envelope from the first request and through replay, so parent-sent instructions are never presented to a child as direct user instructions. (#169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Control UI turns keep running:** chat turns from paired devices survive ordinary pairing activity such as node heartbeats, other devices' updates, and tab reconnects; real revocations still stop them. (#169457, #169134) Thanks @Oldrich333.

### Changes

- **Tool approval hooks:** ordinary hooks can no longer rewrite trusted-inline-approved tool arguments without another approval, and transforming plugins must request separate approval for their final arguments or the call is blocked; see `docs/plugins/hooks/tool-policy.md` for migration. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Codex runtime compatibility:** plugin admission rejects official Codex runtimes below 2026.9.7 with update and repair guidance, and incompatible plugins stay inspectable without being imported. (#168930, #168748, #168749, #168977) Thanks @ezimerman.
- **Session notices:** creating many sessions gives the main session one summary of new sessions instead of separate notices that crowd out reminders and wakes. (#168239)
- **Update performance:** updates stop rehashing unchanged runtime files while retaining the running updater and publishing the candidate, reducing update I/O. (#168958)

### Fixes

- **Tool Search provenance:** network results reached through Tool Search and Code Mode now taint the turn the same way direct network tool calls do. (#169560, #169332) Thanks @RomneyDa and @farisoftfry.
- **Subagent provenance:** child sessions keep the inter-session safety envelope on every replayed turn, and inter-session turns keep a stable provider prompt prefix across later turns and Gateway restarts. (#169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Node commands and approvals:** approved node commands replay when their prepared plan omitted session identity, Windows node shell commands keep quoted arguments, safe-bin commands accept trailing whitespace, and the Linux node service keeps its PATH when the login shell resets it. (#161980, #151622, #158160, #142847, #168120, #136677, #134354) Thanks @Program-123, @gaojian125, @Dimitri-lcht, @igs-rogenlo, @yetval, @harjothkhara, and @abacha.
- **Private reasoning:** unfinished model reasoning stays private when a reply hits a token limit or content filter after a tool call. (#168294)
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps blocked plugins' authored entries, enablement, policy, and slots; refuses to merge malformed UTF-8 root memory; captures Canvas and Memory Core files in new recovery copies (and works on installs with no configured agents); skips redundant cron backups for unchanged one-shot jobs; and honors Windows permissions for SQLite recovery snapshots. (#168111, #168066, #169029, #168567, #169436, #169516, #168938, #168838, #169397) Thanks @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @harshitgupta31415, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Memory:** daily-note flushes reject copied saved content instead of repeating blocks, and correcting an embedding provider's endpoint or credential refreshes cached index managers without a Gateway restart. (#168123, #151263, #151055) Thanks @ruel225 and @Mirksen.
- **Restart recovery:** main sessions that were mid-turn during a Gateway restart resume on the next boot, interrupted completion replies are delivered instead of lost, and new replies wait for their agent to finish starting instead of failing with `prepared reply dispatch runtime owner was not published`. (#168651, #167814, #167766, #168826, #157814) Thanks @goutamadwant, @marknilsn, and @xiaozishan.
- **Reply routing:** WebChat task completions stay in WebChat, mirrored external sends no longer change a transcript's reply destination, and Reef carries GitHub commit links without flagging their revision IDs as credentials. (#168248)
- **Prompt caching:** conversations whose first message ends in whitespace keep a byte-stable prompt prefix, and OpenAI-compatible and local endpoints keep runtime context in a user-role message. (#168725, #168546, #164791) Thanks @flanker-stack.
- **Compaction:** sessions skip a redundant host compaction after native-only compaction, safeguard compaction keeps configured AGENTS.md sections, and memory-flush runs keep provider-native compaction off. (#168051, #168015, #168446, #168131, #168164) Thanks @ruel225, @xydigitLybnnnn, @robertoronderosjr, @jakeaadams, and @obviyus.
- **Control UI:** chat turns survive unrelated pairing activity, typed `/stop` also cancels queued turns for the session, and open chats recover after a Gateway update or recovery reload instead of sticking on **Server updated → Retry now**, keeping their place. (#169457, #169134, #167860, #167859, #168941, #169194) Thanks @Oldrich333 and @masatohoshino.
- **Telegram:** polling connects again when the ingress worker runs from a source checkout or packaged plugin build, and tables next to quotes or lists keep their boundaries and values. (#154286, #154180, #168383, #168366) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui, @markfietje, @dhruv1220, and @barry-ssb.
- **Channels and voice:** channels start again after a stopped-Tailscale failure, the Matrix probe stops its client after checking identity, and `openclaw voicecall steer` keeps stdout machine-readable JSON. (#162266, #168587) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Agent turns:** scheduled and ordinary turns reach the configured fallback after a provider timeout, queued follow-ups that switch model clear the auto-fallback probe, cancelled queued CLI work never runs, empty stream heartbeats no longer count as model progress, malformed tool calls whose argument length is 401 or 403 are not reported as auth failures, valid tool argument union values keep their type, and plugin completions keep working after another plugin reloads. (#168605, #160440, #160428, #169303, #145850, #168500, #168450, #158974, #168916, #156026) Thanks @hxy91819, @changeroa, @RileyJJY, @TYY-2005, @r3n3x, @Shenrui-Ma, and @jalehman.
- **Claude CLI:** Claude CLI models stay listed after another plugin's config changes, exec-completion turns keep their native and MCP tools, and saved session MCP server selections apply on the next turn. (#168315, #168670, #168342, #168393, #168207) Thanks @obviyus, @Oldrich333, and @dprev.
- **OpenRouter prompt caching:** cache-TTL context pruning now arms for Grok and Gemini 2.5+ models on OpenRouter. (#169548, #169133) Thanks @RomneyDa and @gregb100.
- **Models and providers:** API-key sign-in discovers the provider's models immediately, shared OAuth credentials refresh with historical agent stores, switching back to an OpenAI model works without the Codex plugin, timed-out Codex discovery clients are reaped, LM Studio waits for slow model loads instead of overflowing a fresh session, and credential removal during a model reload no longer leaves a restart warning. (#168617, #168957, #169412, #168365, #168044) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Model catalog memory:** a long-running Gateway's model-catalog worker evaluates an unchanged installed native ESM plugin once per workspace instead of retaining another copy of its module graph on every config change, and a failed native refresh re-registers the requested config on the next request. (#169272, #169321, #159662) Thanks @obviyus, @mcooks-cmd, @RomneyDa, and @svdinu-jpg.
- **MCP computer control:** computer control is released with its run, so later calls no longer fail with `COMPUTER_HOST_BUSY`. (#151127, #147420) Thanks @ylcn91 and @vovarbv.
- **Automations:** cron target and payload validation errors are reported as invalid requests, and Workboard fallback runs stay active until the overall outcome settles. (#169102, #168215, #167574) Thanks @obviyus, @skyzhao1223, and @asikorskiy.
- **Agents API sessions:** saved remote sessions continue with the same session ID across binding upgrades. (#168150)
- **Large Gateways:** large fleets reserve session stores without stack overflows, and process-owning Gateway stops no longer wait on native skills watcher cleanup. (#168354, #168160, #168273) Thanks @609NFT and @obviyus.
- **Updates and recovery:** managed updates settle eligible stale package recovery after a lost or replaced handoff lease database and archive completed receipts before the next preparation; `--dry-run` only reports the planned settlement. (#169038, #167506, #167771) Thanks @mkdelta221 and @waynegault.
- **Legacy update records:** 2026.9.8 package recovery records settle by identity and version after metadata drift, completed-receipt identity drift no longer blocks updates, and public repair exits nonzero with guidance when a journal stays pending. (#169027, #168856, #168388, #168092) Thanks @chedong, @k94118, and @RomneyDa.
- **Update outcomes:** accepted Gateway update handoffs are not reported as failures, recorded successes stay successful with a warning about stopped channels, original failures survive unavailable cleanup reporting, repaired migrations stop producing stale warnings, package verification tolerates clock jumps, and migrated-state failures point to `openclaw update repair`. (#168993, #168870, #169037, #169454, #169004, #168835, #168905) Thanks @sayitfast, @hannesrudolph, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Update memory and webhooks:** update children inherit the managed service's heap limits so Doctor finishes on large agent databases, and official webhook plugins deferred during candidate Doctor keep their listeners, including Teams' historical port 3978. (#168889, #168729, #169035, #168872) Thanks @bluet and @sirius1024.
- **Update runtimes:** updater workers stay on the retained runtime and `openclaw doctor --fix` reclaims retained runtimes when the install path uses a Windows short (8.3) name or different casing, and updates no longer copy unrelated dependencies into the retained runtime. (#169292, #168927) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update diagnostics:** an unsealed original-state capture warning names the affected database, and a candidate config read failure warning includes its reason. (#169282, #169259, #169284, #169261) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Codex Ultrafast:** ChatGPT sign-in sessions keep Ultrafast on resumed turns instead of dropping to Fast after the first turn. (#169265, #169264) Thanks @SanderHelgesen.
- **npm-global updates:** the updater runtime keeps only OpenClaw's own dependencies instead of every unrelated package in the global `node_modules`. (#169551, #169373) Thanks @RomneyDa and @holgergruenhagen.
- **Update exit handling:** a completed update whose result reporting fails exits with its warning instead of opening interactive failure triage. (#168587)
- **Doctor maintenance:** Doctor and update repair enter maintenance on a running systemd Gateway even when checking a large state database is slow. (#168161, #168031) Thanks @obviyus and @Tosko4.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.1..8ed6123845921594f4643c1914e8ceb8cfb42c07 history: 91 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 91 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.2
releases.body:
## 2026.10.2

### Highlights

- **Updates from 2026.10.1:** the first upgrade from stable 2026.10.1 now completes cleanly, successful in-place updates no longer end in errors, and Windows, cloned-filesystem, and private-Node update paths finish instead of stalling or rolling back. (#168849, #169031, #165233, #166530, #168968, #164677, #165257) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jarvisnextgeneration20-lang, and @MrJanvar.
- **Doctor and update recovery:** Doctor no longer stops on residual legacy imports, stale Gateway locks, slow state inspection, memory reindex locks, or allowlists for removed channel accounts, and stale-receipt sessions keep their current data. (#166397, #165355, #165417, #168161, #166517, #167651, #165775) Thanks @coolcoolwcr, @obviyus, @Tosko4, @noelff, @oshunter, @donquiche61, and @RomneyDa.
- **Provider-native compaction:** OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes now default to provider-native compaction, and compaction recovers when the primary auth profile is cooling down. (#168164, #166459) Thanks @obviyus and @hawkit.
- **Secret redaction:** credentials that cross a chunk boundary in long tool output are now masked, and redaction of large text no longer stalls or overflows the stack while running several times faster. (#161480, #166701, #167943) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Prompt-cache stability:** Anthropic conversation checkpoints, enriched user prompts, tool results, and inter-session provenance stay byte-identical across follow-ups, replays, Gateway restarts, and subagent completions, so cached prefixes keep hitting. (#168042, #167938, #168392, #167898, #169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** Control UI reconnects, model changes with large plugins, dashboard title work, and catalog loading no longer freeze the Gateway or hang new sessions. (#167374, #161267, #162689, #166089, #166376) Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @ericcaiwx-star, @cursoragent, @dimonnld, and @dprev.

### Changes

- Defaulted OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes to provider-native compaction. (#168164) Thanks @obviyus.
- Reported finalized update successes and suppressed channels as warnings instead of failures. (#169037)
- Stopped live npm dist-tag drift from failing already-validated release candidates. (#168836) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Fixed credential leaks across redaction chunk boundaries and redaction stalls on large tool output. (#161480) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Fixed replies lost while an agent finishes starting, streamed Telegram replies vanishing when the replacement message never lands, and Telegram treating local owner rejection as ambiguous delivery. (#168826, #164649, #167470) Thanks @xiaozishan, @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @jmar5439, and @mgr-nick.
- Fixed Claude CLI sessions showing runtime prompts as user messages, routed CLI prompts appearing on the owner's side of history, lost replies after long streamed turns, and post-turn compaction failing without an Anthropic API key. (#166080, #163521, #153545, #162066) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @rogeriochaves, @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @methylester, @llmsommelier, and @ajmtrz.
- Fixed subagent and ACP answers being truncated, superseded child answers delivered by late receipts, and requester turns stopping when completion delivery expires. (#165800, #162843, #166139, #164282) Thanks @yetval, @holgergruenhagen, @zyz619963502zyz, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.
- Fixed runs aborted as stalled after completed async tools or while waiting on plugin approval, context-engine advancement lost after steering, and the tool loop refilling from the wrong context window. (#166997, #161821, #168394, #166120) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @hannesrudolph, @fransqaas, @obviyus, @robertoronderosjr, @ruel225, and @igs-rogenlo.
- Fixed OpenAI turns failing on regex-lookaround tool schemas, ChatGPT websocket expiry and 16 MiB SSE limits, strict chat templates after runtime notices, and Code Mode calls with repeated tool-call IDs. (#166999, #167063, #166853, #167309, #165210) Thanks @scs0209, @cursoragent, @obviyus, @adamjgmiller, @Jackten, @jlapenna, and @RomneyDa.
- Fixed Codex sessions stopping after thread unloads, leaked app-server clients after model discovery timeouts, provider failures shown as a silent stop, and max thinking dropping on cron and hook turns. (#166693, #168365, #165488, #165444) Thanks @jalehman, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.
- Fixed sessions failing every turn after a truncated image, the agent disowning earlier image answers, and memory_search snake_case arguments being rejected through tool_call. (#166564, #166165, #158632) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @mirasrael, @nogikeyaksh, @masatohoshino, and @obviyus.
- Fixed scheduled cron runs losing the Gateway plugin registry, manual cron runs losing tool access, runs rejected after catalog publication, and preflight compaction skipped for completion turns. (#166991, #168037, #168410, #163117) Thanks @67-luck, @lucianosmori, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @SunnyShu0925, and @AXEG0.
- Fixed the Control UI hold-to-dictate button stopping on release, typed /stop letting queued turns restart the agent, repeated browser replies after background work, and pending Home creation notices piling up. (#166843, #167860, #166362, #168239) Thanks @alfredjbclaw, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, and @shakkernerd.
- Fixed update failures from absolute avatar paths, refused finalize steps leaving the Gateway stopped, and the SQLite worker launch error hidden behind a TypeError. (#164638, #166548, #165373) Thanks @nitinjwadhawan and @Shirleyyyhk.
- Fixed worker capacity leaks after forced descendant cleanup and browser tab eviction at the managed tab cap. (#168746, #166666) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @ruel225, and @obviyus.
- Fixed Feishu replaying obsolete streaming previews, Bedrock custom provider routes using the wrong region, the egress proxy CA rejected by strict TLS clients, and quoted Windows shell arguments in the node host. (#166610, #164406, #165818, #158160) Thanks @rudycelekli, @Takhoffman, @Ayushdevo, @obviyus, @kai-ocean-kurt, @vortexopenclaw, @RyanSandoval, @Dimitri-lcht, and @igs-rogenlo.
- Fixed macOS crashes: the Swift compiler crash in the sidebar picker, Rosetta segfaults, Intel worker startup, and managed llama.cpp setup on macOS below 13.3. (#165573, #165088, #161876, #163358) Thanks @shakkernerd, @NovaUnboundAi, @VACInc, and @xXG0DLessXx.
- Logged update config fallback diagnostics as warnings and unblocked production lint suppression checks. (#165539, #166841) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.1..64cec484d6b34d913854b6fa965635c272a1533f history: 85 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 85 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Safer updates:** updates finish across devices, filesystems, Windows elevation, and interrupted activations, and recover from stale leases or changed evidence instead of stranding the install or blocking future updates. (#164636, #164769, #165257, #165863, #166548, #166695, #168043, #166394, #167302) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @MrJanvar, @Shirleyyyhk, @farisoftfry, @neilofneils404, and @shanselman.
- **Restart-safe conversations:** interrupted turns, first messages during worktree preparation, and deferred tasks resume after a Gateway restart, and user input and committed session data survive restarts, concurrent writes, and failed publications. (#165333, #166042, #165184, #166238, #165502, #167570, #163258, #166010, #167662) Thanks @masatohoshino, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
- **Faster, steadier Gateway:** session, transcript, history, and metadata reads move onto worker threads with far less SQLite work per turn, and startup maintenance runs after readiness so busy Gateways stay responsive. (#164744, #165470, #165614, #166587, #167194, #164779, #165028, #166041, #167278, #165993) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Reliable turns and subagents:** turns recover from stalled streams, reused tool-call IDs, and expired ChatGPT websockets, incomplete turns end with a visible notice, and subagent results keep returning through follow-ups, restarts, and expired delivery windows. (#165983, #167013, #165212, #167063, #167972, #164282, #168068, #166846, #166139, #165987) Thanks @cestercian, @Irish-Joseph, @rmyers64, @sszyh2026, @Jackten, @Oldrich333, @obviyus, @stackingrockss, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, and @LifeViwer.
- **X channel:** answer X (Twitter) mentions through a new channel plugin with streaming, guest mode for repository questions, and enforced API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165354, #165351)
- **Voice calls:** voice calls gain per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Smarter model pickers:** pickers lead with each provider's recommended models, show newly listed Claude, ChatGPT, and Ollama models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, and stay responsive while catalogs load. (#167370, #166737, #167658, #167387, #167463, #165989) Thanks @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @dprev.
- **ClawHub in the Gateway:** browse and search ClawHub plugins and skills from the Gateway, and plugins automatically pick the newest official release your OpenClaw supports. (#163459, #167485, #166588) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @charlesBerg-ux.

### Changes

- **Sessions:** allow directed sends to a session without granting transcript access. (#164444)
- **Worker-local inference:** add a native worker inference runtime with Gateway dispatch, client placement, required worker policy and destination checks before local inference, and clear setup-failure explanations. (#158902, #163645, #163646, #163647, #166611, #166613, #165960) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Public threads:** open public threads at their regular links. (#166049)
- **Subagent progress:** count running subagents on the working line, name launched subagents in the operations group, and continue a resumed answer in the block that handed off. (#165477, #165725, #165542) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **X channel:** add the X (Twitter) mentions channel plugin with Activity API streaming and backfill, repository-question guest mode with hidden same-agent helpers, GitHub-verified repository writers, and daily and monthly X API cost limits. (#165138, #165337, #165376, #165354, #165543, #168071, #165351) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Automation repair:** let a failing automation's owner conversation repair it before alerting, give a second repair turn when the error changes, and post a clear warning when a repair turn times out. (#161007, #162702, #162772) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Channel progress:** show useful Telegram and Discord progress by default, add per-tool glyphs to Discord progress drafts, restore per-tool emoji on Telegram tool rows, and hide routine Slack reaction rows. (#166861, #168032, #167392, #166880) Thanks @obviyus, @keshavbotagent, and @notmnp.
- **Skills:** keep learned skills focused on repeatable procedures rather than facts or codebase knowledge, and keep longer legacy Workshop skills manageable. (#167404, #167639) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Memory:** explain why trigger recall is skipped and why embedding responses are rejected, and report managed Ollama and LM Studio embedding readiness. (#164409, #168035, #156483) Thanks @Ayushdevo, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- **Models and catalogs:** show each provider's recommended models first in pickers, publish curated per-provider recommendations in catalog v2, lead NVIDIA recommendations with its featured models, and apply downloaded catalogs without a Gateway restart. (#167370, #166737, #167989, #158000) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Anthropic and Claude CLI:** support Claude Haiku 5.5, show newly listed Claude models without waiting for an OpenClaw release, list each Claude CLI model once, and keep logged-out Claude CLI models listed with a login reason. (#166706, #167658, #166311, #166338, #167942) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
- **OpenAI:** support custom realtime voice endpoints, show account chat models missing from the manifest, surface new ChatGPT-login models without a release, and stop offering ChatGPT-only or bundled-Codex-rejected models that would fail. (#165632, #162563, #167387, #167633, #167975) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @obviyus.
- **Tool rows and subagent progress:** show Tool Search calls in native tool rows with shared tool icons across clients, show the subagent wait in place without handoff markers, and guide users after HTTP 400 prompt-size rejections. (#165095, #165378, #159712) Thanks @shakkernerd and @sunlit-deng.
- **Voice calls:** add per-call briefs, call reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection to voice calls. (#165716) Thanks @mbelinky and @jacobtomlinson.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.1-beta.2

Changes since [2026.10.1-beta.1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/tag/v2026.10.1-beta.1), the previous npm beta-channel version. This is a hotfix beta covering 40 intervening commits, not a repeat of the cumulative October notes.

### Highlights

- **Updates and Doctor:** recover archive migrations and interrupted updates without leaving managed Gateways stopped, and restore Gateway lifecycle commands on macOS 12 and disabled Windows tasks. (#165854, #164636, #164849, #163317, #164728) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Olli0103, @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @szef-svg, @izrl613, @NovaUnboundAi, and @xXG0DLessXx.
- **Replies and messaging:** preserve completed answers after silent follow-ups, let Discord corrections pass deferred messages, and restore Telegram sends and buttons after channel-routed handoffs. (#164774, #164896, #159265, #165137) Thanks @obviyus, @aatreya, and @mbelinky.
- **Plugins and cloud workers:** keep plugin skills available during checkout updates, avoid slow native-prebuild scans, and include required external-plugin runtime chunks in cloud-worker bootstrap. (#165882, #165301, #165669) Thanks @RomneyDa, @goutamadwant, @exGeni, @LiuwqGit, and @JakeBotFleet.

### Changes

No new capabilities; this beta focuses on fixes and recovery.

### Fixes

- **Agent-to-agent authentication:** reject unresolved peer-token references and report actionable peer-status warnings instead of continuing with an unusable credential. (#165021) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Command execution:** reject NUL-containing command arguments before starting helpers or replacing an existing run, avoiding later shutdown failures from malformed commands. (#164770) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **Update recovery:** avoid launcher-ownership failures in non-root updates, settle pending recovery after lease-database replacement, and keep archive recovery from stranding a stopped Gateway. (#164636, #164849, #165854) Thanks @hrp6vv9mwr-glitch, @szef-svg, @izrl613, @RomneyDa, and @Olli0103.
- **Doctor and migrations:** import sessions from older completed migration receipts while retaining current sessions, verify snapshots on Linux hosts without file birthtime, and skip empty migration scans on unconfigured Matrix installations. (#164867, #164363, #165209) Thanks @hshs38033-cmd, @jayzhou2309, and @StevenKrebs.
- **Managed services:** restore stop, restart, and update commands on macOS 12 Monterey, and let Doctor recover disabled Windows Gateway tasks while status identifies the disabled task. (#163317, #164728) Thanks @NovaUnboundAi, @xXG0DLessXx, and @RomneyDa.
- **Updater compatibility:** complete the published October-beta cleanup path and retain loadable checkout-plugin skills during updates. (#165855, #165882) Thanks @shakkernerd and @RomneyDa.
- **Control UI:** keep bundled UI assets readable under arbitrary container UIDs instead of returning HTTP 503. (#165880) Thanks @RomneyDa and @Conan-Scott.
- **Channel handoffs:** restore Telegram sends and inline buttons after routed chat handoffs, and let newer Discord messages steer active work while an earlier message is deferred. (#165137, #159265) Thanks @mbelinky and @aatreya.
- **Agent replies:** keep completed answers when a follow-up produces no reply, and preserve answers that already explain an approval or input blocker. (#164774, #164896) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Memory and turns:** avoid session-indexing locks on rollback-journal databases and recover a turn when its database worker exits before an operation is dispatched. (#164624, #163258) Thanks @triciah73, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
- **Codex interruptions:** preserve the shared client after a confirmed interruption so the replacement turn need not wait for unrelated active chats. (#165487)
- **Gateway tools and plugins:** keep CLI bridge calls usable after the creating turn completes, and preserve plugin session state through Gateway restarts. (#165428, #164975) Thanks @nano-richtera.
- **Plugin loading and workers:** avoid repeated native-prebuild scans and include hidden runtime chunks required by external plugins when dispatching cloud workers. (#165301, #165669) Thanks @goutamadwant, @exGeni, @LiuwqGit, and @JakeBotFleet.
- **Code Mode:** improve tool-call schema compatibility by using the unambiguous `awaitResults` argument. (#165022)

**Upgrading from an already-blocked older updater:** these fixes do not patch the CLI already installed on your machine. If its preflight refuses the upgrade, install the new CLI manually before rerunning Doctor.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.1-beta.1..c58cf3afa0793257a8127ae868d5e159da6d9d0a history: 26 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 26 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.1-beta.1
releases.body:
## 2026.10.1-beta.1

Changes since [2026.9.8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/tag/v2026.9.8), the version selected by the npm beta channel before this release. Already-shipped contributions from that stable release are excluded from the record below.

### Highlights

- Code Mode can keep small session-scoped values across cells, replies, and Gateway restarts with `store` and `load` (#164086).
- Control UI adds click-to-play YouTube cards, nested Workboards in the sidebar, and automatic pinning for boards you create (#164576, #164604).
- Import readable coding-agent transcripts into durable OpenClaw sessions, with private drafts by default and incremental reimport (#161955).
- Configure off-machine backups to external disks, NAS storage, or Cloudflare R2, with visible backup health and results (#161913).
- Automations can check conditions without a model run, call explicitly allowed MCP servers, and expose cross-job history and inventory search (#101195, #160995, #148947, #150097) Thanks @obviyus and @Alix-007.
- Installed-skill search and reading make admitted skills discoverable even when their instructions do not fit the initial prompt budget (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Selected memory plugins can own their pre-compaction flush, preserving memory through their own persistence tools (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
- Cloud-worker preparation supports configured GitHub Enterprise hosts for repository discovery and prepared workflows (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.

### Changes

- Code Mode persistence is scoped to interactive sessions, limited to 256 KiB per value and 1 MiB per session; failed cells do not commit their pending writes (#164086).
- MCP Apps can request permission to call a specific tool while their view remains open. The grant is tied to that view and requester, expires after ten minutes or view closure, and is not a persistent model-tool allowlist (#164496).
- YouTube cards retain a watch-link fallback; sandboxed chat views remain link-only (#164576).
- Transcript import supports readable Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and OpenClaw catalogs through the CLI and Control UI. Reimport appends new items, and incomplete or bounded history reads are reported (#161955).
- Backup storage locations require configuration and explicit initialization; scheduled backups can target external disks/NAS or Cloudflare R2. Client-side encryption is available, with an explicit operator option to disable it (#161913).
- Installed-skill search covers names, descriptions, and instruction content, with full instruction reading under existing sandbox and policy controls. It does not install marketplace skills or expand permissions (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Condition scripts can skip quiet automation checks and use explicitly permitted MCP servers. Scripts and event triggers are enabled by default unless `cron.triggers.enabled` is set to `false` (#101195, #160995) Thanks @obviyus.
- Eligible failing conversation-owned automations can request repair in their owner conversation before their first chat alert; later failures still alert. Setting `failureAlert: false` disables both repair requests and alerts (#161007) Thanks @obviyus.
- Control UI sessions gain emoji reactions without starting an agent turn, plus sidebar snooze/wake controls. Snoozing parks navigation; it does not suspend ongoing work (#161053, #161960).
- Opt-in immutable installation adoption can prepare sealed generations and explicitly activate or recover them on supported root-managed Linux installations with cgroup v2 and compatible launcher/schema support. `--no-restart` remains preparation-only; existing installations are not converted automatically (#163799, #164306).
- Existing agents can be migrated to local Claws with the explicit, consented `openclaw claws migrate <agent-id>` workflow, preserving their workspace and sessions. Migration is not automatic (#162329) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- Memory-plugin pre-compaction flushes can use plugin-owned persistence tools and read-only lookups; the default Memory Core behavior is unchanged (#162177) Thanks @jalehman.
- GitHub Enterprise repository preparation requires matching-host credentials; worker-side `gh` CLI authentication remains a separate setup requirement (#160108) Thanks @galiniliev.

### Plugin SDK migration

- Breaking change: third-party plugins importing retired compatibility facades or whole-session-store helpers must migrate before upgrading. Use focused channel/config/session APIs and row-level session operations; bundled callers are migrated, but external-plugin compatibility is not assumed. See [SDK migration guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration) (#162220, #162333, #163366).
- Awaited session persistence APIs commit through the writer. Deprecated synchronous adapters remain until the next major with warnings; this addition does not require a data conversion (#163264).

### Fixes

- Session continuity: preserve usage during registry changes, deliver remote-worker attachments, keep queued cancellations from stalling active turns, and apply turn timeouts through transcript aliases (#164217, #164219, #164230, #164289) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- Paired nodes and plugin policy: align continuation signatures and apply `before_agent_run` policy to node turns, with lifecycle fences for queued plugin work (#164287, #164270, #164247) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Memory and transcript persistence: bound embedding-cache migrations and report oversized rows, reduce transcript-copy overhead, and move lifecycle writes off the main thread (#164303, #164251, #163815).
- Replies and media: render supported local videos inline with actionable rejected-link errors, suppress preview cards on Telegram progress messages, and keep speech-only replies working alongside reasoning (#164137, #163727, #164285) Thanks @ivan-magda, @obviyus, and @Twilight-Networks.
- Update and Doctor recovery: surface recorded serving verdicts, repair installations with read-only managed configuration, distinguish a still-starting Gateway from failure, and keep cleanup output from corrupting JSON results (#164193, #164235, #164261, #164312) Thanks @DonnieFi, @JD8855122, and @waynegault.
- Already-current updates retain and apply the legacy config repair plan, including no-op updates without an explicit channel change. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Doctor and command shutdown: keep maintenance available under shared-lease liveness rules and report schema/manifest outcomes; drain lifecycle workers and shared state on CLI exit, preserving successful command results when overdue plugin cleanup produces a warning (#164697, #164853, #164915).
- Install/update responsiveness: avoid repeated configuration reads, duplicate backups for shared database profiles, serial metadata waits, and unnecessary pnpm-root probes; successful cleanup progress no longer appears as an error (#164182, #164186, #164183, #164184, #163477) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- Windows and browser startup: handle empty and nested Windows worktrees, redirected Linux Chromium caches, and automatic Playwright Chromium startup on ARM64 (#164202, #164249, #163510, #163281) Thanks @ly85206559, @obviyus, and @jesse-merhi.
- Cloud workers and Crabbox: retain real failure causes, correct Linux lease handling, overlap bundle downloads, avoid unrelated warm-image cleanup waits, and prevent slow reads or unsupported backends from stranding workers (#164129, #164187, #164128, #164231).
- Plugins and provider execution: capture package imports under Bun, reuse prerelease metadata, and avoid treating expired remote-execution approval as an authentication-profile failure (#164223, #164185, #164237).
- MCP Apps: keep forms, file handoffs, and context synchronization working across app interactions (#164277).
- Session views and model status: reuse prepared session facts and cards, keep canonical state handles, and resolve agent-local model aliases in status output (#164218, #164301, #164110, #164126) Thanks @ooiuuii and @obviyus.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete 842697352d230da72571fdbf06440c325e7cc34c..6830fe76b3db05ad59e8ff7f0f872d4e2639a1fe history: 2,403 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 2,403 unique PRs. releases.name: openclaw 2026.8.35
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.9.7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.9.7)

## 2026.8.35

### Highlights

- **GPT-6.1 Sol support:** add the current Sol model across OpenAI routing, discovery, reasoning, harness, and Reef guard-model boundaries. (#161400, #162955)
- **Safer updates and recovery:** preserve plugin settings, prevent duplicate Gateways, handle pnpm package updates without terminal failures, and retain plugin inventory through migration. (#160344, #160193, #161920, #161485) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @grtninja, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @aniruddhaadak80.
- **Reliable agent completion:** preserve complete delegated and CLI answers, release suspended child capacity, recover full cron output, and prevent failed requests from consuming steered questions. (#162843, #162368, #160520, #162439) Thanks @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, @jayzhou2309, and @obviyus.
- **Security and ownership hardening:** keep secret-store kinds stable during rotation, restore admitted secret-egress execution, and retain explicit cron tool allowlists while repairing stale automatic snapshots. (#160926, #160760, #162432) Thanks @zachisfine, @yetval, @VACInc, and @obviyus.
- **Channel and integration reliability:** repair Gmail and IMAP watchers, Matrix direct mappings, Telegram progress, remote MCP startup, and managed llama.cpp startup on clean Windows hosts. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546, #162376, #163093) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, @VACInc, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
- **Performance and UI continuity:** bound model-catalog waits, reduce Codex fleet heap pressure, and keep saved WebChat replies visible across history refresh races. (#161132, #162912, #162763) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @Flakedict, @obviyus, @609NFT, and @VACInc.

### Changes

- **Extended-stable release preparation:** align OpenClaw and every publishable official plugin to 2026.8.35 while preserving the 2026.8.34 publication contract.
- **Model compatibility:** add GPT-6.1 Sol to the branch-native OpenAI and Reef compatibility owners. (#161400, #162955)

### Fixes

- **Update safety:** preserve incompatible-plugin settings through recovery, keep retained plugin records during migration, avoid pnpm terminal failures, and carry the existing Gateway lock through container/direct startup. (#160344, #161485, #161920, #160193) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @aniruddhaadak80, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @grtninja.
- **Agent delivery:** recover uncapped cron replies, preserve complete CLI subagent answers, honor skipped announcements, retain detached transcripts, release suspended child slots, and keep failed requests from replacing earlier questions with a steer. (#160520, #162843, #161542, #161091, #162368, #162439) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, and @obviyus.
- **Cron and tools:** bound thinking-catalog hydration, repair stale automatic tool snapshots without widening explicit allowlists, and deliver manual runs after their creating turn ends. (#161132, #162432, #162780) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @Flakedict, and @obviyus.
- **Sessions and tool results:** reject malformed session targets, preserve spawned working directories, project deeply nested MCP results safely, and keep remote MCP bundles working in native sessions. (#161533, #162308, #160825, #162376) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @Takhoffman, @hpyhandsome, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Channels:** recover Gmail transient binds, bound IMAP backlog processing, restore Matrix direct mappings, and restore Telegram progress when hooks suppress previews. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, and @VACInc.
- **Runtime reliability:** prevent redaction stalls, cancel stale thinking-catalog waits, pass the responding agent to TTS model selection, stop durable worker retries from freezing hosts, reduce Codex fleet heap use, and install the required Visual C++ runtime after a managed llama.cpp launch failure. releases.name: openclaw 2026.8.34
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.9.7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.9.7)

## 2026.8.34

### Highlights

- **Extended-stable correctness rollup:** backport 113 audit-selected fix units across upgrades, Doctor, authentication, sessions, channels, plugins, sandboxing, filesystem safety, model runtimes, and release packaging.
- **Complete rescan:** re-evaluate the full 2026.8.33 discovery range, large mixed-purpose pull requests, and the 2026.7.35 lineage instead of advancing only from the previous backport cursor.
- **Upgrade and recovery hardening:** preserve credentials, agent state, plugin inventory, transcripts, schedules, service ownership, and runtime links through upgrades, restarts, and Doctor repair.
- **Boundary fixes:** tighten remote filesystem mutation, plugin and skill scanning, browser authentication, channel reply identity, private skill ingress, and scoped runtime ownership.

### Changes

- **Extended-stable release preparation:** align OpenClaw, publishable plugins, native version metadata, generated channel catalogs, and npm package inventories to 2026.8.34.

### Fixes

- **Plugins:** Recover orphan installs without weakening ownership.
- **Doctor:** Repair keyed multi-agent rosters without ownership (#134706)
- Prevent device pairing migration crash on contaminated records.
- **Doctor:** Preserve per-agent memory search during upgrades.
- **Doctor:** Detect shared auth migration by provenance (#134808)

releases.name: openclaw 2026.8.33
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.9.6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.9.6)

## 2026.8.33

### Highlights

- **Current flagship models:** add Meta Muse Spark 1.3, Anthropic Fable 5.1, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, and OpenAI/fal GPT Image 2.5 support to the extended-stable line. (#135638, #136553, #137550, #143068, #143069)
- **Complete GPT-5.6 family support:** preserve Sol, Terra, and Luna catalog, routing, migration, image, vision, and thinking behavior, including Ultra reasoning across model-runtime boundaries and Bedrock tool-result images. (#135397, #149336)
- **Extended-stable security rollup:** reconcile all repository advisories that affect 2026.8.2, harden Prometheus metrics authorization and Discord asset/voice ownership, and clear the production Nodemailer advisory gate. (#136700, #137433, #140334, #140903)

### Changes

- **Extended-stable release preparation:** normalize OpenClaw, all publishable plugins, and native version metadata to 2026.8.33 while retaining the release-line-compatible publication workflows from 2026.8.2.

### Fixes

- **Anthropic reasoning continuity:** preserve Fable 5.1 reasoning through model switches and runtime events. (#136782)
- **OpenAI discovery:** require successful model discovery before offering GPT-6 Astra through OAuth. (#137561)
- **Doctor skill state:** preserve explicitly enabled skills during automatic updates. (#138730)
- **Generated media:** retain generated images when a later tool call fails. (#131226)
- **Matrix verification:** refresh verification state before reporting device trust. (#136226)
- **Prometheus authorization:** reject metric scrapes that lack the configured operator-read scope. (#140903)
- **Discord media policy:** enforce sender media policy for guild asset uploads. (#140334)
- **Discord realtime ownership:** preserve speaker and playback ownership across voice lifecycle transitions. (#137433)
- **Discord consult cancellation:** record host-cancelled realtime consults as cancellation, suppress the generic error fallback, and keep the voice session ready for the next request. (#134924, #135380)
- **Dependency security:** override the IMAP dependency graph to Nodemailer 9.1.1, clearing the address-parser denial-of-service and related domain/content-access advisories. (#136700)
- **iOS release validation:** update the WebRTC binary dependency to 152.0.0 after the 151.0.0 artifact was withdrawn. (#134942)

releases.name: openclaw 2026.7.35
releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of July 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.9.5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.9.5)

## 2026.7.35

### Fixes

- **Doctor plugin registry:** preserve the complete bundled plugin inventory when Doctor creates or repairs registry state, so default Browser, Canvas, pairing, file-transfer, phone-control, Talk voice, and Bonjour plugins remain available after restart. State-migration discovery now also recovers from the partial registry written by 2026.7.34 while retaining external plugin install records. Backported from #136045. Thanks @wangmiao0668000666.

### Complete contribution record

This extended-stable follow-up was selected from a complete 1,418-commit audit after the prior 2026.7.34 audit cursor. No other defect observed during clean install or the 2026.6.35 upgrade required a July-line backport.

## Cumulative July extended-stable notes

OpenClaw 2026.7.33 and 2026.7.34 were unstable extended-stable builds and were intentionally not published as GitHub Releases. Because 2026.7.35 is the first GitHub Release for the July maintenance line, it includes their complete changelogs below.

## 2026.7.33

### Highlights

- **Security and credential safety:** harden command parsing, browser origin checks, plugin Git installs, diagnostics, service credentials, and webhook logging across Gateway and official plugins.
- **Message and session integrity:** preserve queued, imported, streamed, and tool-result messages across retries, hooks, recovery, and channel lifecycle transitions.
- **Gateway reliability:** close failed HTTP and Responses streams, bound expensive reads and history queries, and settle shutdown work before reporting completion. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Channel delivery:** repair Discord, Matrix, Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, LINE, Feishu, Zalo, and meeting-plugin edge cases that could lose, corrupt, or stall messages.
- **Provider and media robustness:** bound provider requests and diagnostics, reject malformed payloads, and preserve valid tool schemas and response lifecycles. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Extended-stable release tooling:** carry the current Docker channel classifier, promoter, verification policy, and tests so `v2026.7.33` can move only the `extended-stable*` aliases. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Security boundaries:** reject escaped-newline command words, exact-origin mismatches, injected Git option arguments, inherited secret-response identifiers, unsafe browser mutations, and malformed or oversized node payloads.
- **Delivery and transcript recovery:** keep retry delays accurate, preserve imported messages and plugin-blocked tool results, retain detached admissions, and avoid silently dropping channel actions or recovery work. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Resource and lifecycle safety:** bound catalog, history, media, stderr, API, and provider waits; stop canceled parallel tools; drain channel shutdown; and reject queued worker requests after close. Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Text and schema correctness:** preserve UTF-16 boundaries across user-visible truncation paths, keep root tool-schema properties, reject non-finite schema values, and report exact UTF-8 write sizes.
- **Official plugins:** repair message parsing, proxy paths, request timeouts, media handling, privacy-safe logging, and runtime aliases across the npm-published plugin inventory.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.7.1-2..42625327f91254cfe66cbeb6d7a1812780b1a694 history: 126 merged PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

#### Pull requests

- **PR #102438** fix: auth bookkeeping no longer reverts rotated OpenAI OAuth credentials. Related #102430. Thanks @obviyus.
- **PR #102125** fix(gateway): finish plugin HTTP responses after post-header failures. Thanks @mushuiyu886.

- **PR #114512** fix(cron): avoid false agent timeouts while execution lanes are busy. Thanks @hugin-bot.
- **PR #112352** fix(model): report the model change before the thinking remap it triggers. Thanks @kesava500.
- **PR #114540** fix(cron): prevent local model preflight socket leaks. Thanks @hugenshen.
- **PR #114500** fix(auto-reply): normalize newline-delimited silent tokens. Related #103735. Thanks @Maless88.
- **PR #97024** fix(session-delivery): propagate non-ENOENT retry persistence failures. Thanks @0xghost42.
- **PR #114076** fix: debug proxy respects response backpressure (issue #105701). Thanks @qingminglong and @aniruddhaadak80.
- **PR #128799** fix(ai): preserve root properties when flattening root-level anyOf tool schemas. Related #128743. Thanks @LiuwqGit and @Patrick-Erichsen and @schaba21.
- **PR #131546** fix(copilot): own BYOK response stream lifecycles. Related #131544.
- **PR #131195** fix(line): /card splits an action, list item, or receipt entry at a comma inside its data. Related #129349. Thanks @edenfunf and @obviyus.
- **PR #131783** fix(agents): keep dangling symlinks visible in ls listings.
- **PR #132014** fix(line): give the agent the selection a postback carries. Related #132000. Thanks @edenfunf and @obviyus.
- **PR #102636** fix(handoff): skip orchestrator framing for solo agents without subagents. Related #102628. Thanks @Gary-Jia-new and @altaywtf and @Joakim-Emanuelson.
- **PR #132545** fix(plugins): keep compiled plugin aliases on the built runtime.
- **PR #102160** fix(agents): run-lifecycle reliability — bounded release, evidence-based liveness, watchdog semantics. Related #85826, #96168. Thanks @obviyus and @kiagentkronos-cell and @alvelda.

## 2026.7.34

### Highlights

- **Current model families:** add GPT-6 Astra, GPT Image 2.5 Flare/Sunburst, Muse Spark 1.3, Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6/3.7 Flash, Grok 4.6, Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, Qwen 3.8, DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning support across the provider catalogs and runtime policies that ship on extended stable. Fable 5.1 remains deferred because its prefix-bound reasoning contract requires the newer append-only replay lifecycle.
- **GPT-5.6 compatibility:** retain and verify the complete GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna family across direct OpenAI and Codex OAuth routing, reasoning controls, pricing, context, and vision metadata.

### Fixes

- **Installer recovery:** preserve the original npm recovery diagnostics when an install repair attempt also fails, so operators see the actionable package-manager error instead of a secondary cleanup failure.

### Complete contribution record

This extended-stable candidate was selected from a complete 11,198-commit audit after `v2026.7.33`. It adapts the approved provider and installer slices to the 7.33 SDK and configuration surface without importing later architectural refactors.

### Release verification

- Docker publication recovery: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35598889849
